source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ־בִּן־נ֠וּן מִֽן־הַשִּׁטִּ֞ים שְׁנַֽיִם־אֲנָשִׁ֤ים מְרַגְּלִים֙ חֶ֣רֶשׁ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְכ֛וּ רְא֥וּ אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְאֶת־יְרִיח֑וֹ וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ בֵּית־אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֛ה וּשְׁמָ֥הּ רָחָ֖ב וַיִּשְׁכְּבוּ־שָֽׁמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Joshua son of Nun from the Shittim two men spying secretly, saying, go, see the land and Jericho. And they went and came [to the] house of a woman, a prostitute, and her name [was] Rahab, and they lay down there.

en.L: And Joshua son of Nun sent two men from Shittim as spies, secretly, saying, "Go, look over the land, and Jericho." And they went and came into the house of a woman, a prostitute, and her name [was] Rahab, and they lay down there.
en.B: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two men from Shittim to spy. "Go and look over the land," he told them, "and Jericho above all." So they set off and came to the house of a prostitute named Rahab, and they stayed the night there.
en.R: Joshua son of Nun was camped at Shittim. From there he sent out two men in secret to spy. He told them, "Go and look over the land, especially the city of Jericho." So the two men went. They came to the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there for the night.

sw.L: Yoshua mwana wa Nuni akatuma kutoka Shitimu watu wawili kuwa wapelelezi kwa siri, akisema, "Nendeni, mkaitazame nchi, na Yeriko." Nao wakaenda, wakaingia katika nyumba ya mwanamke kahaba, na jina lake [lilikuwa] Rahabu, nao wakalala huko.
sw.B: Kisha Yoshua mwana wa Nuni aliwatuma watu wawili kwa siri kutoka Shitimu wakapeleleze. Aliwaambia, "Nendeni mkaitazame nchi, na hasa Yeriko." Basi wakaondoka, wakafika kwenye nyumba ya kahaba mmoja aitwaye Rahabu, wakalala huko usiku ule.
sw.R: Yoshua mwana wa Nuni alikuwa amepiga kambi huko Shitimu. Kutoka huko aliwatuma watu wawili kwa siri wakapeleleze. Aliwaambia, "Nendeni mkaitazame nchi, hasa mji wa Yeriko." Basi watu hao wawili walikwenda. Wakafika kwenye nyumba ya kahaba mmoja aitwaye Rahabu, wakalala huko usiku ule.

es.L: Y Josué hijo de Nun envió desde Sitim a dos hombres como espías, en secreto, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}}, {{plural_you:examinen|examinad}} la tierra, y Jericó». Y fueron y entraron en la casa de una mujer, una prostituta, cuyo nombre [era] Rahab, y se acostaron allí.
es.B: Entonces Josué hijo de Nun envió en secreto desde Sitim a dos hombres para espiar. Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} a examinar la tierra, y sobre todo Jericó». Ellos partieron y llegaron a la casa de una prostituta llamada Rahab, y pasaron allí la noche.
es.R: Josué hijo de Nun estaba acampado en Sitim. Desde allí envió en secreto a dos hombres para espiar. Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} a examinar la tierra, sobre todo la ciudad de Jericó». Así que los dos hombres fueron. Llegaron a la casa de una prostituta llamada Rahab y pasaron allí la noche.

fr.L: Et Josué fils de Noun envoya de Shittim deux hommes comme espions, en secret, en disant : « Allez, observez le pays, et Jéricho. » Et ils allèrent et entrèrent dans la maison d’une femme, une prostituée, et son nom [était] Rahab, et ils se couchèrent là.
fr.B: Josué fils de Noun envoya en secret deux hommes de Shittim pour espionner. « Allez examiner le pays, leur dit-il, et surtout Jéricho. » Ils partirent et arrivèrent à la maison d’une prostituée nommée Rahab, et ils y passèrent la nuit.
fr.R: Josué fils de Noun campait à Shittim. De là, il a envoyé en secret deux hommes pour espionner. Il leur a dit : « Allez examiner le pays, surtout la ville de Jéricho. » Les deux hommes sont donc partis. Ils sont arrivés chez une prostituée qui s’appelait Rahab, et ils y ont passé la nuit.

vi.L: Và Giô-suê con trai Nun bí mật sai hai người từ Si-tim đi do thám, mà rằng: "Hãy đi, xem xét xứ ấy và Giê-ri-cô." Và họ đi và vào nhà của một người đàn bà, một kỹ nữ, tên [là] Ra-háp, và họ nằm nghỉ tại đó.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Giô-suê con trai Nun bí mật sai hai người từ Si-tim đi do thám. Ông dặn họ: "Hãy đi xem xét xứ ấy, nhất là thành Giê-ri-cô." Vậy họ lên đường, đến nhà một kỹ nữ tên là Ra-háp, và ngủ đêm tại đó.
vi.R: Giô-suê con trai Nun đang đóng trại tại Si-tim. Từ đó ông bí mật sai hai người đi do thám. Ông dặn họ: "Hãy đi xem xét xứ ấy, nhất là thành Giê-ri-cô." Vậy hai người ra đi. Họ đến nhà của một cô gái làm nghề mại dâm tên là Ra-háp và ngủ lại đó qua đêm.

ko.L: 그리고 눈의 아들 여호수아가 싯딤에서 두 사람을 정탐꾼으로 몰래 보내며 말했다. "가서 그 땅과 여리고를 살펴보아라." 그러자 그들이 가서 한 여자, 곧 창녀의 집에 들어갔는데, 그 여자의 이름은 라합이었다. 그들은 거기에서 묵었다.
ko.B: 눈의 아들 여호수아가 싯딤에서 두 사람을 몰래 정탐꾼으로 보냈다. 여호수아가 그들에게 말했다. "가서 그 땅을 살펴보아라. 특히 여리고를 잘 살펴보아라." 그들은 길을 떠나 라합이라는 창녀의 집에 이르러, 그곳에서 밤을 지냈다.
ko.R: 눈의 아들 여호수아는 싯딤에 진을 치고 있었다. 여호수아는 그곳에서 두 사람을 몰래 정탐꾼으로 보냈다. 여호수아가 그들에게 말했다. "가서 그 땅을 살펴보아라. 특히 여리고 성을 잘 살펴보아라." 두 사람은 길을 떠났다. 그들은 라합이라는 창녀의 집에 가서 그날 밤 거기에서 묵었다.

pt.L: E Josué, filho de Num, enviou secretamente de Sitim dois homens como espiões, dizendo: "Vão, vejam a terra e Jericó." E eles foram e entraram na casa de uma mulher, uma prostituta, e o nome dela [era] Raabe, e se deitaram ali.
pt.B: Então Josué, filho de Num, enviou secretamente de Sitim dois homens para espionar. "Vão e observem a terra", disse a eles, "e sobretudo Jericó." Eles partiram e chegaram à casa de uma prostituta chamada Raabe, e passaram a noite ali.
pt.R: Josué, filho de Num, estava acampado em Sitim. De lá ele mandou dois homens em segredo para espionar. Ele lhes disse: "Vão e observem a terra, principalmente a cidade de Jericó." Os dois homens foram. Chegaram à casa de uma prostituta chamada Raabe e ficaram ali para passar a noite.

am.L: የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱም ከሰጢም ሁለት ሰዎችን በስውር ሰላዮች አድርጎ እንዲህ ብሎ ላካቸው፦ «ሂዱ፤ ምድሪቱንና ኢያሪኮን እዩ።» እነርሱም ሄደው ወደ አንዲት ሴት፣ ወደ ዝሙት አዳሪ ቤት ገቡ፤ ስሟም ረዓብ ነበር፤ በዚያም ተኙ።
am.B: ከዚያም የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ ሁለት ሰዎችን ከሰጢም በስውር ሰላዮች አድርጎ ላከ። «ሂዱ፤ ምድሪቱን ቃኙ» አላቸው፤ «በተለይም ኢያሪኮን።» እነርሱም ሄደው ረዓብ ወደምትባል ወደ አንዲት ዝሙት አዳሪ ቤት ደረሱ፤ በዚያም አደሩ።
am.R: የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ በሰጢም ሰፍሮ ነበር። ከዚያም ሁለት ሰዎችን በስውር ሰላዮች አድርጎ ላከ። «ሂዱ፤ ምድሪቱን፣ በተለይም የኢያሪኮን ከተማ ቃኙ» አላቸው። ሁለቱ ሰዎችም ሄዱ። ረዓብ ወደምትባል ወደ አንዲት ዝሙት አዳሪ ቤት ደርሰው በዚያ አደሩ።

hi.L: और नून के पुत्र यहोशू ने शित्तीम से दो पुरुषों को भेदियों के रूप में चुपके से यह कहकर भेजा, "जाओ, देश को, और यरीहो को, देखो।" और वे गए, और एक स्त्री के, एक वेश्या के घर में आए, और उसका नाम राहाब [था], और वे वहाँ लेटे।
hi.B: तब नून के पुत्र यहोशू ने शित्तीम से दो पुरुषों को चुपके से भेद लेने भेजा। "जाओ, देश का भेद लो," उसने उनसे कहा, "और सबसे बढ़कर यरीहो का।" वे चल पड़े और राहाब नाम की एक वेश्या के घर पहुँचे, और रात को वहीं ठहरे।
hi.R: नून का पुत्र यहोशू शित्तीम में डेरा डाले हुए था। वहाँ से उसने दो आदमियों को चुपके से भेद लेने भेजा। उसने उनसे कहा, "जाओ और देश को देख आओ, ख़ासकर यरीहो नगर को।" वे दोनों आदमी चले गए। वे राहाब नाम की एक वेश्या के घर पहुँचे और रात को वहीं ठहरे।

ru.L: И послал Иисус, сын Навина, из Ситтима двух человек лазутчиками тайно, говоря: «Идите, осмотрите землю и Иерихон.» И они пошли, и пришли в дом женщины-блудницы, и имя её Раав, и легли там.
ru.B: Затем Иисус, сын Навина, тайно послал из Ситтима двух человек на разведку. «Идите, осмотрите землю», — сказал он им, — «и прежде всего Иерихон.» Они отправились в путь, пришли в дом блудницы по имени Раав и остановились там на ночь.
ru.R: Иисус Навин стоял лагерем в Ситтиме. Оттуда он тайно послал двух человек на разведку. Он сказал им: «Идите и осмотрите землю, особенно город Иерихон.» Эти двое пошли. Они пришли в дом блудницы по имени Раав и остались там на ночь.

uk.L: І послав Ісус Навин із Шиттіму двох чоловіків як вивідувачів потай, кажучи: «Ідіть, огляньте землю і Єрихон.» І пішли вони, і прийшли в дім жінки, блудниці, а імʼя їй — Рахав, і лягли там.
uk.B: Тоді Ісус Навин потай послав із Шиттіму двох чоловіків на розвідку. «Ідіть і огляньте землю», — сказав він їм, — «і насамперед Єрихон.» Тож вони вирушили й прийшли до дому блудниці на імʼя Рахав і заночували там.
uk.R: Ісус Навин стояв табором у Шиттімі. Звідти він потай послав двох чоловіків на розвідку. Він сказав їм: «Ідіть і огляньте землю, особливо місто Єрихон.» Тож ці двоє пішли. Вони прийшли до дому блудниці на імʼя Рахав і залишилися там на ніч.

decisions.choice: Shittim: Israel's last camp east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Shittim ("acacia trees") is on the plains of Moab, where Israel camped before crossing (Numbers 25:1; 33:49). The camp moves from there to the Jordan in 3:1.

decisions.choice: the land, and Jericho: Jericho in particular
alternatives: the land and the city of Jericho as two separate tasks
decisions.reason: The "and" picks out the first city in their path from the land as a whole. Jericho guarded the way up from the Jordan into the hill country.

decisions.choice: a woman who was a prostitute, named Rahab
decisions.reason: The word (zonah) is the ordinary word for a woman who sells sex (Genesis 38:15; Leviticus 21:7). An old Aramaic translation of Joshua calls her an innkeeper, perhaps to soften the story, but the Hebrew word does not mean that. The New Testament keeps the plain sense: it names "Rahab the prostitute" as an example of faith that acted (Hebrews 11:31; James 2:25). A stranger's coming and going at such a house would draw less notice.

decisions.choice: they lay down there: they lodged for the night
decisions.reason: The verb means to lie down, and in a setting like this it is the ordinary word for staying the night (verse 8 says they had not yet lain down to sleep). Nothing in the story says the men used her as a prostitute.

decisions.choice: a prostitute named Rahab
alternatives: a woman, a prostitute, whose name was Rahab
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "a woman, a prostitute, and her name was Rahab"; Balanced and Readable join the three parts into one phrase, and Literal keeps them.

decisions.choice: Joshua son of Nun was camped at Shittim
decisions.reason: Readable says what Shittim was, so the reader knows where the spies started (m1).

decisions.choice: "Rahabu", "kahaba", "Yeriko", "Shitimu"
decisions.reason: For the whole of Joshua: "Rahabu yule kahaba" and "Yeriko" are the forms already published in the Swahili of Hebrews 11:30-31 and James 2:25, so the book keeps them. "Kahaba" is the plain, standard word for a prostitute; "malaya" is coarser.

decisions.choice: "Rahab", "prostituta"
decisions.reason: The name keeps the form Spanish already uses in Hebrews 11:31 and James 2:25, where she is "Rahab la prostituta". "Prostituta" is the plain word for the Hebrew zonah, as in those passages.

decisions.choice: "Shittim", "Jéricho", "Rahab"
decisions.reason: For the whole of Joshua 1-12: "Jéricho" and "Rahab" are the forms already used in Hebrews 11:30-31 and James 2:25. Other names follow the French of the Pentateuch, which writes "sh" for the Hebrew sound (Shittim, Heshbon, Bashân).

decisions.choice: "Ra-háp"; "kỹ nữ" (L, B), "cô gái làm nghề mại dâm" (R)
decisions.reason: The name keeps the form already published in Hebrews 11:31 and James 2:25. James 2:25 calls her "kỹ nữ", Hebrews 11:31 "gái mại dâm"; Literal and Balanced take the first, the plainer word of the two in a story; Readable says plainly what her trade was, as Hebrews does.

decisions.choice: "창녀 라합" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word plainly means a prostitute. The Korean New Testament of this translation already calls her "창녀 라합" (Hebrews 11:31; James 2:25), so Joshua uses the same word and the same form of her name.

decisions.choice: Raabe, uma prostituta (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 6:17, 22-25). "Raabe" is the Brazilian form of the name that Hebrews 11:31 and James 2:25 already use in Portuguese, and "prostituta" is the word those verses use for her ("Raabe, a prostituta"). The Hebrew word is the ordinary one for a woman who sells sex (m3), so Portuguese uses the plain word at every level and does not soften it to "hospedeira" or raise it to the old "meretriz".

decisions.choice: Sitim; Jericó
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the Brazilian forms of the names, "Sitim" as Numbers 25:1 has it in Portuguese and "Jericó" as Numbers 22:1 and the Gospels have it.

decisions.choice: "ዝሙት አዳሪ" for Rahab's trade at every level, and "ረዓብ" for her name, as Hebrews 11:31 has "ዝሙት አዳሪዋ ረዓብ"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names a woman who sold sex, and the Pentateuch's Amharic uses "ዝሙት አዳሪ" for it (Genesis 38); Hebrews 11:31 calls her the same. "ጋለሞታ" in James 2:25 is older and harsher in tone, and "innkeeper" softens what the text says.

decisions.choice: "ተኙ" (L) for "they lay down"; "አደሩ" (B, R), "they spent the night"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew verb, which here means that they lodged for the night (meaning decision m4); Balanced and Readable say that plainly.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Joshua 2.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change; pronouns for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: "राहाब वेश्या"; "भेदिये" for the spies
decisions.reason: Rahab keeps the form of Hebrews 11:31 and James 2:25 in this translation ("राहाब वेश्या"), and the spies are "भेदिये", as in Hebrews 11:31. The same through Joshua.

decisions.choice: "वे वहाँ लेटे" (they lay down there)
decisions.reason: The verb means they lodged for the night (m4). Literal keeps "लेटे"; Balanced and Readable say "रात को वहीं ठहरे".

decisions.choice: блудница Раав (Раав not declined)
decisions.reason: Rahab keeps the name and title she has in Hebrews 11:31 and James 2:25 in this translation, so the reader can follow her from Joshua to the New Testament. The name is not declined (к Раав, дом Раав), as in those verses.

decisions.choice: лазутчики (L); на разведку, разведчики (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words Hebrews 11:31 uses for these men in this translation: лазутчики at Literal, разведчики at Balanced and Readable. соглядатаи is out of use.

decisions.choice: "Рахав", "Єрихон", "Шиттім"; "блудниця" at every level
decisions.reason: "Рахав" is the form of Matthew 1:5 and James 2:25 in this translation, and "блудниця" the word James uses of her; the place names take their traditional Ukrainian forms.

source.text: וַיֵּ֣אָמַ֔ר לְמֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיח֖וֹ לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה אֲ֠נָשִׁים בָּ֣אוּ הֵ֧נָּה הַלַּ֛יְלָה מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַחְפֹּ֥ר אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was said to [the] king of Jericho, saying, look, men have come here tonight from [the] sons of Israel to search out the land.

en.L: And it was told to the king of Jericho, saying, "Look, men have come here tonight from the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel to search out the land."
en.B: The king of Jericho was told, "Some men from the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} have come here tonight to search out the land."
en.R: Someone told the king of Jericho, "Listen! Some men from Israel came here tonight. They have come to find out about our land."

sw.L: Mfalme wa Yeriko akaambiwa, akisema, "Tazama, watu wamekuja hapa usiku huu kutoka kwa wana wa Israeli ili kuipeleleza nchi."
sw.B: Mfalme wa Yeriko aliambiwa, "Watu fulani wa Waisraeli wamekuja hapa usiku huu kuipeleleza nchi."
sw.R: Mtu mmoja alimwambia mfalme wa Yeriko, "Sikiliza! Watu kutoka Israeli wamekuja hapa usiku huu. Wamekuja kuipeleleza nchi yetu."

es.L: Y se le dijo al rey de Jericó: «Mira, unos hombres de los hijos de Israel han venido aquí esta noche para explorar la tierra».
es.B: Al rey de Jericó le avisaron: «Unos hombres de los israelitas han venido aquí esta noche para explorar la tierra».
es.R: Alguien le dijo al rey de Jericó: «¡Escucha! Unos hombres de Israel llegaron aquí esta noche. Han venido para averiguar cómo es nuestra tierra».

fr.L: Et il fut dit au roi de Jéricho, en disant : « Voici, des hommes sont venus ici cette nuit, des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, pour explorer le pays. »
fr.B: On vint dire au roi de Jéricho : « Des hommes d’entre les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} sont venus ici cette nuit pour explorer le pays. »

vi.L: Và có người báo cho vua Giê-ri-cô rằng: "Kìa, đêm nay có những người từ con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên đã đến đây để dò xét xứ."

vi.R: Có người đến báo với vua Giê-ri-cô: "Xin vua hãy nghe! Đêm nay có mấy người từ Y-sơ-ra-ên đến đây. Họ đến để dò la xứ của chúng ta."

ko.L: 그러자 여리고 왕에게 이런 말이 전해졌다. "보십시오, 오늘 밤 이스라엘 자손 가운데서 사람들이 이 땅을 정탐하러 이곳에 왔습니다."
ko.B: 누군가 여리고 왕에게 알렸다. "이스라엘 자손 가운데서 몇 사람이 오늘 밤 이 땅을 정탐하러 이곳에 왔습니다."
ko.R: 누군가 여리고 왕에게 말했다. "들어 보십시오! 오늘 밤 이스라엘에서 몇 사람이 이곳에 왔습니다. 그들은 우리 땅을 알아보러 왔습니다."

pt.L: E foi dito ao rei de Jericó: "Eis que vieram aqui esta noite homens dos filhos de Israel para explorar a terra."
pt.B: Avisaram o rei de Jericó: "Alguns homens dos israelitas vieram aqui esta noite para fazer o reconhecimento da terra."
pt.R: Alguém disse ao rei de Jericó: "Escute! Alguns homens de Israel chegaram aqui esta noite. Eles vieram descobrir tudo sobre a nossa terra."

hi.R: किसी ने यरीहो के राजा से कहा, "सुनिए! आज रात इस्राएल से कुछ आदमी यहाँ आए हैं। वे हमारे देश का भेद लेने आए हैं।"

ru.L: И было сказано царю Иерихона, говоря: «Вот, мужи пришли сюда этой ночью из {{gender:детей Израиля|сынов Израиля}}, чтобы высмотреть землю.»

ru.R: Кто-то сказал царю Иерихона: «Послушай! Этой ночью сюда пришли люди из Израиля. Они пришли разузнать о нашей земле.»

uk.L: І сказали цареві Єрихону, кажучи: «Ось прийшли сюди цієї ночі чоловіки з {{gender:нащадків Ізраїля|синів Ізраїля}}, щоб розвідати землю.»
uk.B: Цареві Єрихону донесли: «Якісь чоловіки з ізраїльтян прийшли сюди цієї ночі, щоб розвідати землю.»
uk.R: Хтось сказав цареві Єрихону: «Слухай! Якісь чоловіки з Ізраїлю прийшли сюди цієї ночі. Вони прийшли, щоб вивідати про нашу землю.»

decisions.choice: the king of Jericho: the ruler of a city-state
decisions.reason: Canaan was divided among many small cities, each with its own king (12:9-24 lists thirty-one of them). Jericho's king ruled the city and the land around it.

decisions.choice: to search out the land: to explore it for an attack
decisions.reason: The verb (chafar) means to dig or search; here it is to find out the land's ways in, as in Deuteronomy 1:22.

decisions.reason: Readable keeps the sentence short; the people are the same.

decisions.choice: the informant says "ይስሙ!" (respectful) to the king
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch, subjects speak to a king with the respectful form; Readable's added "Listen!" therefore takes it.

decisions.reason: People speak to a king with "आप", as the note settles, so the call to attention takes the polite form.

records.literal_gloss: And sent [the] king of Jericho to Rahab, saying, bring out the men, the [ones] coming to you who came into your house, for to search out all the land they have come.

en.L: And the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, "Bring out the men who came to you, who came into your house, for they have come to search out all the land."
en.B: So the king of Jericho sent word to Rahab: "Bring out the visitors who came to you and went into your house. They have come to spy out the whole land."
en.R: So the king sent a message to Rahab. It said, "Bring out the men who came to your house. They are spies. They have come to look over our whole land."

sw.L: Mfalme wa Yeriko akatuma kwa Rahabu, akisema, "Watoe watu waliokuja kwako, walioingia nyumbani mwako, kwa maana wamekuja kuipeleleza nchi yote."
sw.B: Basi mfalme wa Yeriko alituma ujumbe kwa Rahabu: "Watoe wageni waliokuja kwako na kuingia nyumbani mwako. Wamekuja kuipeleleza nchi yote."
sw.R: Basi mfalme alituma ujumbe kwa Rahabu. Ulisema, "Watoe watu waliokuja nyumbani kwako. Ni wapelelezi. Wamekuja kuipeleleza nchi yetu yote."

es.L: Y el rey de Jericó envió a Rahab, diciendo: «Saca a los hombres que vinieron a ti, que entraron en tu casa, porque han venido a explorar toda la tierra».
es.B: Entonces el rey de Jericó le mandó este mensaje a Rahab: «Saca a los visitantes que llegaron a ti y entraron en tu casa. Han venido a espiar toda la tierra».
es.R: Entonces el rey le envió un mensaje a Rahab. Decía: «Saca a los hombres que llegaron a tu casa. Son espías. Han venido a examinar toda nuestra tierra».

fr.L: Et le roi de Jéricho envoya [dire] à Rahab : « Fais sortir les hommes qui sont venus chez toi, qui sont entrés dans ta maison, car c’est pour explorer tout le pays qu’ils sont venus. »
fr.B: Le roi de Jéricho fit dire à Rahab : « Fais sortir les visiteurs qui sont venus chez toi et sont entrés dans ta maison. Ils sont venus espionner tout le pays. »
fr.R: Alors le roi a envoyé un message à Rahab. Il disait : « Fais sortir les hommes qui sont venus dans ta maison. Ce sont des espions. Ils sont venus examiner tout notre pays. »

vi.L: Và vua Giê-ri-cô sai người đến nói với Ra-háp rằng: "Hãy đem ra những người đã đến với cô, là những người đã vào nhà cô, vì họ đến để dò xét cả xứ."
vi.B: Vậy vua Giê-ri-cô sai người đến bảo Ra-háp: "Hãy đem ra những người khách đã đến với cô và vào nhà cô. Họ đến để dò thám cả xứ này."
vi.R: Vậy vua sai người đến nói với Ra-háp: "Hãy đem ra những người đã đến nhà cô. Họ là gián điệp. Họ đến để dò xét cả xứ của chúng ta."

ko.L: 그러자 여리고 왕이 라합에게 사람을 보내어 말했다. "너에게 온 사람들, 곧 네 집에 들어간 그 사람들을 끌어내라. 그들은 이 온 땅을 정탐하러 왔다."

ko.R: 그래서 왕은 라합에게 사람을 보내어 말을 전했다. "네 집에 온 그 사람들을 끌어내라. 그들은 정탐꾼이다. 우리 온 땅을 살피러 왔다."

pt.B: Então o rei de Jericó mandou dizer a Raabe: "Entregue os visitantes que vieram até você e entraram na sua casa. Eles vieram espionar a terra inteira."
pt.R: Então o rei mandou uma mensagem a Raabe. Ela dizia: "Traga para fora os homens que foram à sua casa. Eles são espiões. Vieram examinar toda a nossa terra."

am.L: የኢያሪኮም ንጉሥ ወደ ረዓብ እንዲህ ብሎ ላከ፦ «ምድሪቱን ሁሉ ሊመረምሩ መጥተዋልና ወደ አንቺ የመጡትን፣ ወደ ቤትሽ የገቡትን ሰዎች አውጪ።»
am.B: ስለዚህ የኢያሪኮ ንጉሥ ወደ ረዓብ እንዲህ የሚል መልእክት ላከ፦ «ወደ አንቺ መጥተው ቤትሽ የገቡትን እንግዶች አውጪ፤ ምድሪቱን ሁሉ ሊሰልሉ መጥተዋልና።»
am.R: ስለዚህ ንጉሡ ወደ ረዓብ መልእክት ላከ። መልእክቱም እንዲህ ይል ነበር፦ «ወደ ቤትሽ የመጡትን ሰዎች አውጪ። ሰላዮች ናቸው። ምድራችንን ሁሉ ሊሰልሉ መጥተዋል።»

ru.L: И послал царь Иерихона к Раав, говоря: «Выведи мужей, пришедших к тебе, которые вошли в твой дом, ведь высмотреть всю землю они пришли.»
ru.B: Тогда царь Иерихона послал сказать Раав: «Выведи гостей, которые пришли к тебе и вошли в твой дом. Они пришли разведать всю землю.»
ru.R: Тогда царь послал к Раав людей с приказом: «Выведи мужчин, которые пришли в твой дом. Это разведчики. Они пришли осмотреть всю нашу землю.»

uk.L: І послав цар Єрихону до Рахав, кажучи: «Виведи чоловіків, які прийшли до тебе, які ввійшли в твій дім, бо вони прийшли розвідати всю землю.»
uk.B: Тож цар Єрихону послав сказати Рахав: «Виведи чоловіків, що прийшли до тебе й увійшли в твій дім. Вони прийшли вивідати всю землю.»
uk.R: Тож цар послав до Рахав людей зі звісткою: «Виведи чоловіків, які прийшли до твого дому. Вони вивідувачі. Вони прийшли оглянути всю нашу землю.»

decisions.choice: who came to you, who came into your house: said twice for force
decisions.reason: The king's message names the men twice over, as if to leave Rahab no room to deny they were there.

decisions.choice: They are spies.

decisions.choice: the king's men call Rahab "cô"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must choose a word for "you". The king's messengers speak to a woman of the town with the plain "cô", neither rude nor deferential; the spies use the same word to her in this chapter.

decisions.choice: the king's order to Rahab is in the plain style (해라체); Rahab answers his men in the formal polite style (합쇼체)
alternatives: the polite style for the king
decisions.reason: A king sends orders to a subject; Rahab speaks to the king's men with the respect owed to officials, while she deceives them.

decisions.choice: você (the king to Rahab); vocês (Rahab to the king's men); você (the spies to Rahab)
decisions.reason: People speak to each other with "você" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4): the king's message to Rahab, the spies' words to her, and her words to the king's men and to the spies ("vocês"). Only God and those who pray say "tu".
