vi.R: Nhưng Ra-háp đã giấu hai người ấy trước rồi. Nàng trả lời: "Đúng là có mấy người đến nhà tôi. Nhưng tôi không biết họ từ đâu đến.

ko.L: 그러나 그 여자는 그 두 사람을 데려다가 숨겨 두었다. 그리고 말했다. "그렇습니다. 그 사람들이 저에게 왔습니다. 그러나 저는 그들이 어디에서 왔는지 알지 못했습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 그 여자는 이미 그 두 사람을 데려다가 숨겨 두었다. 그 여자가 말했다. "맞습니다. 그 사람들이 저에게 오기는 했습니다. 그러나 저는 그들이 어디에서 온 사람들인지 몰랐습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 라합은 이미 그 두 사람을 숨겨 두었다. 라합이 대답했다. "네, 그 사람들이 우리 집에 왔습니다. 그러나 저는 그들이 어디에서 왔는지 몰랐습니다.

pt.L: Mas a mulher tinha tomado os dois homens e os tinha escondido. E ela disse: "Sim, os homens vieram a mim, mas eu não sabia de onde eles [eram].
pt.B: Mas a mulher tinha levado os dois homens e os tinha escondido. "É verdade, os homens vieram até mim", disse ela, "mas eu não sabia de onde eram.
pt.R: Mas Raabe já tinha escondido os dois homens. Ela respondeu: "Sim, os homens vieram à minha casa. Mas eu não sabia de onde eles eram.

am.L: ሴቲቱ ግን ሁለቱን ሰዎች ወስዳ ሸሽጋቸው ነበር። እንዲህም አለች፦ «አዎን፣ ሰዎቹ ወደ እኔ መጥተው ነበር፤ ከወዴት እንደ ሆኑ ግን አላወቅኩም።
am.B: ሴቲቱ ግን ሁለቱን ሰዎች ወስዳ ሸሽጋቸው ነበር። እርሷም፦ «እውነት ነው፤ ሰዎቹ ወደ እኔ መጥተው ነበር» አለች፤ «ነገር ግን ከየት እንደ መጡ አላወቅኩም።
am.R: ረዓብ ግን ሁለቱን ሰዎች አስቀድማ ደብቃቸው ነበር። እርሷም እንዲህ ብላ መለሰች፦ «አዎ፣ ሰዎቹ ወደ ቤቴ መጥተው ነበር። ነገር ግን ከየት እንደ ነበሩ አላወቅኩም።

hi.L: पर उस स्त्री ने उन दोनों पुरुषों को लेकर छिपा दिया था। और उसने कहा, "हाँ, वे पुरुष मेरे पास आए तो थे, पर मैं नहीं जानती थी कि वे कहाँ के [थे]।
hi.B: पर वह स्त्री उन दोनों पुरुषों को ले जाकर छिपा चुकी थी। "यह सच है, वे पुरुष मेरे पास आए थे," उसने कहा, "पर मुझे पता नहीं था कि वे कहाँ से आए थे।
hi.R: पर राहाब उन दोनों आदमियों को पहले ही छिपा चुकी थी। उसने जवाब दिया, "हाँ, वे आदमी मेरे घर आए थे। पर मैं नहीं जानती थी कि वे कहाँ के थे।

ru.L: А женщина взяла двух мужей и спрятала их. И сказала она: «Да, приходили ко мне мужи, но я не знала, откуда они.
ru.B: Но женщина уже взяла двух мужчин и спрятала их. «Это правда, эти люди приходили ко мне», — сказала она, — «но я не знала, откуда они.
ru.R: Но Раав уже спрятала двух мужчин. Она ответила: «Да, эти люди приходили ко мне в дом. Но я не знала, откуда они.

uk.L: А жінка взяла тих двох чоловіків і сховала їх. І сказала вона: «Так, приходили до мене ці чоловіки, але я не знала, звідки вони.
uk.B: Але жінка вже взяла тих двох чоловіків і сховала їх. «Це правда, ці чоловіки приходили до мене», — сказала вона, — «але я не знала, звідки вони.
uk.R: Але Рахав уже сховала тих двох чоловіків. Вона відповіла: «Так, ці чоловіки приходили до мене. Але я не знала, звідки вони.

decisions.choice: had taken ... and hidden them: done before the king's men arrived
alternatives: took and hid them then, while the messengers waited
decisions.reason: The verbs simply carry the story on, but she cannot hide the men in front of the king's messengers. The narrator goes back to tell what she had already done; verse 6 says how.

decisions.choice: hid them: literally "hid him"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pronoun is singular. It may mean she hid each man in turn, or it may treat the pair as one group; the sense is that both were hidden.

decisions.choice: Rahab's answer: a deliberate deception
decisions.reason: Rahab admits what cannot be denied and lies about the rest (verse 5). The story tells it without comment; later Scripture praises her faith and her receiving the spies (Hebrews 11:31; James 2:25), not the lie as such.

decisions.choice: It is true
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word (ken, "so, right") grants the point. Balanced lets her concede it before she misleads them.

decisions.choice: "उन दोनों ... को छिपा दिया" (them)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "hid him" (m2), which reads as each of them or as a slip in the text; Hindi gives the plain sense, "them", at every level, as the English does.

source.text: וַיְהִ֨י הַשַּׁ֜עַר לִסְגּ֗וֹר בַּחֹ֨שֶׁךְ֙ וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים יָצָ֔אוּ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי אָ֥נָה הָלְכ֖וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֑ים רִדְפ֥וּ מַהֵ֛ר אַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם כִּ֥י תַשִּׂיגֽוּם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was [that] the gate [was] to shut at the darkness, and the men went out; not I know where went the men. Pursue quickly after them, for you will overtake them.

en.L: And it was [time] for the gate to be shut at dark, and the men went out. I do not know where the men went. Pursue them quickly, for you will overtake them."
en.B: When the gate was about to be shut at dark, the men left. I do not know where they went. Go after them quickly. You will catch them."
en.R: When it got dark and it was time to close the city gate, the men left. I do not know where they went. Hurry and chase them! You can still catch them."

sw.L: Ikawa [wakati] lango lilipokaribia kufungwa gizani, watu hao wakatoka. Sijui watu hao walikokwenda. Wafuatieni upesi, kwa maana mtawapata."
sw.B: Lango lilipokaribia kufungwa giza lilipoingia, watu hao waliondoka. Sijui walikokwenda. Wafuateni upesi, mtawakuta."
sw.R: Giza lilipoingia na ukawa wakati wa kufunga lango la mji, watu hao waliondoka. Sijui walikokwenda. Fanyeni haraka, mwakimbize! Bado mnaweza kuwakamata."

es.L: Y era [hora] de cerrar la puerta al oscurecer, y los hombres salieron. No sé adónde fueron los hombres. {{plural_you:Persíganlos|Perseguidlos}} pronto, porque los {{plural_you:alcanzarán|alcanzaréis}}».
es.B: Cuando iban a cerrar la puerta, al oscurecer, los hombres se fueron. No sé adónde fueron. {{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} tras ellos enseguida. Los {{plural_you:alcanzarán|alcanzaréis}}».
es.R: Cuando oscureció y era hora de cerrar la puerta de la ciudad, los hombres se fueron. No sé adónde fueron. ¡{{plural_you:Dense prisa|Daos prisa}} y {{plural_you:persíganlos|perseguidlos}}! Todavía {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} alcanzarlos».

fr.L: Et c’était [le moment] où la porte allait être fermée, à la nuit tombée, et les hommes sont sortis. Je ne sais pas où les hommes sont allés. Poursuivez-les vite, car vous les rattraperez. »
fr.B: Au moment où l’on allait fermer la porte, à la nuit tombée, ces hommes sont sortis. Je ne sais pas où ils sont allés. Lancez-vous vite à leur poursuite. Vous les rattraperez. »
fr.R: Quand il a fait nuit et qu’on allait fermer la porte de la ville, ces hommes sont partis. Je ne sais pas où ils sont allés. Dépêchez-vous de les poursuivre ! Vous pouvez encore les rattraper. »

vi.L: Và [lúc] cổng thành sắp đóng khi trời tối, thì những người ấy đi ra. Tôi không biết những người ấy đi đâu. Hãy đuổi theo họ mau, vì các ông sẽ bắt kịp họ."
vi.B: Lúc trời tối, khi cổng thành sắp đóng, thì mấy người ấy đi ra. Tôi không biết họ đi đâu. Các ông hãy mau đuổi theo họ, sẽ bắt kịp họ đấy."
vi.R: Khi trời tối, lúc sắp đóng cổng thành, thì mấy người ấy đã đi rồi. Tôi không biết họ đi đâu. Các ông hãy mau đuổi theo đi! Các ông vẫn còn bắt kịp họ."

ko.L: 어두워져서 성문을 닫을 때가 되자, 그 사람들이 나갔습니다. 그 사람들이 어디로 갔는지 저는 모릅니다. 서둘러 그들을 뒤쫓아 가십시오. 그들을 따라잡을 것입니다."
ko.B: 날이 어두워져 성문을 닫으려고 할 때에 그 사람들이 떠났습니다. 그들이 어디로 갔는지 저는 모릅니다. 빨리 그들을 뒤쫓아 가십시오. 따라잡을 수 있을 것입니다."
ko.R: 날이 어두워져서 성문을 닫을 때가 되자, 그 사람들이 떠났습니다. 그들이 어디로 갔는지는 모릅니다. 서둘러 쫓아가십시오! 아직 따라잡을 수 있습니다."

pt.L: E [era hora de] fechar o portão, ao escurecer, e os homens saíram. Não sei para onde os homens foram. Persigam-nos depressa, porque vocês os alcançarão."
pt.B: Quando o portão estava para ser fechado, ao anoitecer, os homens saíram. Não sei para onde foram. Vão atrás deles depressa, e vocês os alcançarão."
pt.R: Quando escureceu e chegou a hora de fechar o portão da cidade, os homens foram embora. Não sei para onde foram. Corram atrás deles! Vocês ainda podem alcançá-los."

am.L: በጨለማም በሩ የሚዘጋበት ጊዜ በሆነ ጊዜ ሰዎቹ ወጡ፤ ሰዎቹ ወዴት እንደ ሄዱ አላውቅም፤ ፈጥናችሁ ተከታተሏቸው፤ ትደርሱባቸዋላችሁና።»
am.B: ሲመሽ የከተማው በር ሊዘጋ ሲል ሰዎቹ ወጡ። ወዴት እንደ ሄዱ አላውቅም። ፈጥናችሁ ተከተሏቸው፤ ትደርሱባቸዋላችሁ።»
am.R: ጨለማ ሲሆንና የከተማው በር የሚዘጋበት ጊዜ ሲደርስ ሰዎቹ ወጥተው ሄዱ። ወዴት እንደ ሄዱ አላውቅም። ፍጠኑ፤ ተከተሏቸው! አሁንም ልትደርሱባቸው ትችላላችሁ።»

hi.L: और अँधेरा होने पर जब फाटक बंद होने का [समय] था, तब वे पुरुष निकल गए। मैं नहीं जानती कि वे पुरुष कहाँ गए। जल्दी से उनका पीछा करो, क्योंकि तुम उन्हें जा पकड़ोगे।"
hi.B: जब अँधेरा होने पर फाटक बंद होनेवाला था, तब वे पुरुष चले गए। मैं नहीं जानती कि वे कहाँ गए। जल्दी उनका पीछा करो। तुम उन्हें पकड़ लोगे।"
hi.R: जब अँधेरा हो गया और नगर का फाटक बंद करने का समय आया, तब वे आदमी चले गए। मैं नहीं जानती कि वे कहाँ गए। जल्दी करो और उनका पीछा करो! तुम उन्हें अभी भी पकड़ सकते हो।"

ru.L: И было: ворота [надо было] закрывать в темноте, и мужи вышли. Не знаю, куда пошли мужи. Гонитесь скорее за ними, ведь вы догоните их.»
ru.B: Когда в сумерках ворота должны были закрыть, эти люди ушли. Я не знаю, куда они пошли. Скорее гонитесь за ними, и вы их догоните.»
ru.R: Когда стемнело и пора было закрывать городские ворота, они ушли. Я не знаю, куда они пошли. Скорее догоняйте их! Вы ещё можете их поймать.»

uk.L: І коли [треба було] замикати браму в темряві, ці чоловіки вийшли. Не знаю, куди пішли ці чоловіки. Женіться швидко за ними, бо наздоженете їх.»
uk.B: Коли смеркло і браму вже мали замикати, ці чоловіки пішли. Я не знаю, куди вони подалися. Швидше женіться за ними. Ви їх наздоженете.»
uk.R: Коли стемніло і настав час зачиняти міську браму, ці чоловіки пішли. Я не знаю, куди вони пішли. Швидше женіться за ними! Ви ще можете їх наздогнати.»

decisions.choice: the gate was to be shut at dark
decisions.reason: A walled city closed its gate at nightfall for safety (Nehemiah 7:3). Rahab claims the men left just before it closed, so they must already be outside the city.

decisions.choice: for you will overtake them: a reason to hurry
decisions.reason: She urges speed by promising success: they are not far ahead.

decisions.choice: Rahab calls the king's men "các ông" and herself "tôi"
decisions.reason: The polite address of a townswoman to men sent by the king; she speaks to the two spies the same way (verses 9 to 21).

source.text: וְהִ֖יא הֶעֱלָ֣תַם הַגָּ֑גָה וַֽתִּטְמְנֵם֙ בְּפִשְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ הָעֲרֻכ֥וֹת לָ֖הּ עַל־הַגָּֽג׃

records.literal_gloss: And she, she had brought them up to the roof and hid them in [the] flax of the wood, the [ones] laid out by her on the roof.

en.L: But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax that she had laid out on the roof.
en.B: In fact she had brought them up to the roof and covered them with the flax stalks she had spread out there.
en.R: Rahab had really taken the men up to her flat roof. She had hidden them under stalks of flax that she had spread out there to dry.

sw.L: Lakini yeye alikuwa amewapandisha juu ya dari na kuwaficha katikati ya mabua ya kitani, aliyokuwa ameyapanga juu ya dari.
sw.B: Kwa kweli alikuwa amewapandisha juu ya dari ya nyumba na kuwafunika kwa mabua ya kitani aliyokuwa ameyatandaza huko.
sw.R: Kumbe Rahabu alikuwa amewapeleka wale watu juu ya dari tambarare ya nyumba yake. Alikuwa amewaficha chini ya mabua ya kitani aliyoyatandaza huko yakauke.

es.L: Pero ella los había hecho subir a la azotea y los había escondido entre los tallos de lino que tenía extendidos sobre la azotea.
es.B: En realidad, ella los había subido a la azotea y los había tapado con los tallos de lino que había extendido allí.
es.R: En realidad, Rahab había llevado a los hombres a la azotea plana de su casa. Los había escondido debajo de unos tallos de lino que había puesto allí para que se secaran.

fr.L: Or elle les avait fait monter sur le toit et les avait cachés sous les tiges de lin qu’elle avait étalées sur le toit.
fr.B: En fait, elle les avait fait monter sur le toit et les avait couverts avec les tiges de lin qu’elle y avait étalées.
fr.R: En réalité, Rahab avait fait monter les hommes sur le toit plat de sa maison. Elle les avait cachés sous des tiges de lin qu’elle avait étalées là pour les faire sécher.

vi.L: Nhưng nàng đã đem họ lên mái nhà và giấu họ dưới những thân cây gai mà nàng đã trải ra trên mái nhà.
vi.B: Thật ra nàng đã đưa họ lên mái nhà và lấy những thân cây gai nàng đã trải ra ở đó mà phủ lên họ.
vi.R: Thật ra Ra-háp đã đưa hai người lên mái nhà bằng của nàng. Nàng đã giấu họ dưới những thân cây gai nàng trải ra đó để phơi khô.

ko.L: 그러나 그 여자는 그들을 지붕으로 데리고 올라가서, 지붕 위에 자기가 늘어놓은 삼대 줄기 속에 그들을 숨겨 두었던 것이다.
ko.B: 사실 라합은 그들을 지붕으로 데리고 올라가서, 거기에 펼쳐 놓은 삼대 줄기로 그들을 덮어 숨겨 두었던 것이다.
ko.R: 사실 라합은 그 두 사람을 평평한 지붕 위로 데리고 올라갔었다. 그리고 그곳에 말리려고 펼쳐 놓은 삼대 줄기 밑에 그들을 숨겨 두었다.

pt.L: Mas ela os tinha feito subir ao terraço e os tinha escondido entre os talos de linho que ela tinha arrumado sobre o terraço.
pt.B: Na verdade, ela os tinha levado para o terraço e os tinha coberto com os talos de linho que tinha espalhado ali.
pt.R: Raabe tinha mesmo levado os homens para o terraço da casa. Ela os tinha escondido debaixo de talos de linho que tinha espalhado ali para secar.

am.L: እርሷ ግን ወደ ጣሪያው አውጥታቸው ነበር፤ በጣሪያውም ላይ ባሰጣችው በተልባ ዛላ መካከል ሸሽጋቸው ነበር።
am.B: በእርግጥ እርሷ ወደ ጣሪያው አውጥታቸው በዚያ ባሰጣችው የተልባ ዛላ ሸፍናቸው ነበር።
am.R: ረዓብ በእርግጥ ሰዎቹን ወደ ቤቷ ጠፍጣፋ ጣሪያ አውጥታቸው ነበር። በዚያም እንዲደርቅ ባሰጣችው የተልባ ዛላ ሥር ደብቃቸው ነበር።

hi.L: पर वह उन्हें छत पर ले गई थी और सन के उन डंठलों में छिपा दिया था जो उसने छत पर सजाकर रखे थे।
hi.B: असल में वह उन्हें छत पर ले जा चुकी थी और उन्हें सन के उन डंठलों से ढक दिया था जो उसने वहाँ फैला रखे थे।
hi.R: सच तो यह था कि राहाब उन आदमियों को अपनी सपाट छत पर ले गई थी। उसने उन्हें सन के डंठलों के नीचे छिपा दिया था, जिन्हें उसने वहाँ सूखने के लिए फैला रखा था।

ru.L: А она подняла их на кровлю и спрятала их в стеблях льна, разложенных у неё на кровле.
ru.B: А на самом деле она подняла их на крышу и укрыла их стеблями льна, которые разложила там.
ru.R: На самом деле Раав отвела мужчин на свою плоскую крышу. Она спрятала их под стеблями льна, которые разложила там сушиться.

uk.L: А вона вивела їх на дах і сховала їх у стеблах льону, розкладених у неї на даху.
uk.B: Насправді ж вона вивела їх на дах і прикрила стеблами льону, які розклала там.
uk.R: Насправді Рахав завела чоловіків на свій плаский дах. Вона сховала їх під стеблами льону, які розклала там сушитися.

decisions.choice: she had brought them up: told now, done earlier
decisions.reason: The sentence begins with "she" and breaks the run of the story, the Hebrew way of giving background. It explains the hiding of verse 4.

decisions.choice: stalks of flax laid out on the roof
decisions.reason: Roofs were flat and were used for work and sleep (1 Samuel 9:25-26). Flax was pulled in spring (Exodus 9:31) and laid out to dry before its fibers were made into linen. The season fits the crossing at the time of harvest (3:15) and Passover (5:10).

decisions.choice: flat roof ... to dry
decisions.reason: Readable adds what a reader needs to picture the scene (m2).

decisions.choice: "thân cây gai" (stalks of flax)
decisions.reason: Flax is called "cây gai" in ordinary Vietnamese, the plant whose fibers are made into linen ("vải gai"); "lanh" is less widely known.

decisions.choice: o terraço
decisions.reason: The roof was flat and used for work and sleep (m2). Brazilian "telhado" is a sloping tiled roof that no one could walk on; "terraço" is the flat top of a house, so Readable needs no added word where the English Readable says "flat roof". The same in verse 8.

decisions.choice: "ጣሪያ" for the roof, "ጠፍጣፋ ጣሪያ" (flat roof) at Readable; "የተልባ ዛላ" for the stalks of flax
decisions.reason: Most Ethiopian readers know a sloping roof; Readable, as its English level, says that this one was flat, so that people could hide on it and flax could be laid out to dry.

source.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים רָדְפ֤וּ אַֽחֲרֵיהֶם֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן עַ֖ל הַֽמַּעְבְּר֑וֹת וְהַשַּׁ֣עַר סָגָ֔רוּ אַחֲרֵ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָצְא֥וּ הָרֹדְפִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And the men pursued after them [the] way of the Jordan to the fords, and the gate they shut after as the pursuers had gone out after them.

en.L: And the men pursued them on the road to the Jordan, as far as the fords; and they shut the gate after the pursuers had gone out after them.
en.B: So the men set out after them along the road to the Jordan, as far as the river crossings, and as soon as the pursuers had gone out, the gate was shut.
en.R: So the king's men went after the spies. They took the road toward the Jordan River and went as far as the places where people cross it. As soon as they had gone out, the city gate was shut.

sw.L: Nao watu hao wakawafuatia katika njia iendayo Yordani, hadi vivukoni; na lango likafungwa baada ya hao waliowafuatia kutoka nje kuwafuata.
sw.B: Basi watu hao waliwafuatia katika njia iendayo Yordani, hadi kwenye vivuko vya mto. Mara tu wale waliowafuatia walipotoka, lango likafungwa.
sw.R: Basi watu wa mfalme waliwafuata wale wapelelezi. Walishika njia iendayo Mto Yordani, wakafika hadi mahali ambapo watu huvuka mto. Mara tu walipotoka nje, lango la mji likafungwa.

es.L: Y los hombres los persiguieron por el camino del Jordán, hasta los vados; y cerraron la puerta después de que salieron tras ellos los perseguidores.
es.B: Entonces los hombres salieron tras ellos por el camino que lleva al Jordán, hasta los pasos del río, y en cuanto salieron los perseguidores, se cerró la puerta.
es.R: Así que los hombres del rey fueron tras los espías. Tomaron el camino hacia el río Jordán y llegaron hasta los lugares por donde la gente lo cruza. En cuanto ellos salieron, se cerró la puerta de la ciudad.

fr.L: Et les hommes les poursuivirent sur le chemin du Jourdain, jusqu’aux gués ; et on ferma la porte après que les poursuivants furent sortis à leur suite.
fr.B: Les hommes se lancèrent donc à leur poursuite sur la route du Jourdain, jusqu’aux passages du fleuve, et dès que les poursuivants furent sortis, on ferma la porte.
fr.R: Les hommes du roi sont donc partis à la poursuite des espions. Ils ont pris la route du Jourdain et sont allés jusqu’aux endroits où l’on traverse le fleuve. Dès qu’ils sont sortis, on a fermé la porte de la ville.

vi.L: Và những người ấy đuổi theo họ trên đường đến sông Giô-đanh, cho đến các chỗ cạn; và người ta đóng cổng thành sau khi những người đuổi theo đã đi ra đuổi theo họ.
vi.B: Vậy những người ấy đuổi theo họ trên đường đến sông Giô-đanh, cho đến các chỗ qua sông. Ngay khi những người đuổi theo vừa ra khỏi, cổng thành liền đóng lại.
vi.R: Vậy người của vua đuổi theo hai người do thám. Họ đi theo đường về phía sông Giô-đanh, cho đến những chỗ người ta lội qua sông. Ngay khi họ vừa ra khỏi thành, cổng thành liền đóng lại.

ko.L: 그러자 그 사람들은 요단으로 가는 길로 나루터까지 그들을 뒤쫓아 갔다. 그리고 뒤쫓는 사람들이 그들을 따라 나가자마자 성문을 닫았다.
ko.B: 그래서 그 사람들은 요단강으로 가는 길을 따라 강을 건너는 곳까지 그들을 뒤쫓아 갔다. 뒤쫓는 사람들이 나가자마자 성문이 닫혔다.
ko.R: 그래서 왕의 사람들은 정탐꾼들을 뒤쫓아 갔다. 그들은 요단강 쪽으로 난 길을 따라 사람들이 강을 건너는 곳까지 갔다. 그들이 나가자마자 성문이 닫혔다.

pt.L: E os homens os perseguiram pelo caminho do Jordão até os vaus; e fecharam o portão depois que os perseguidores saíram atrás deles.
pt.B: Os homens partiram atrás deles pela estrada do Jordão, até os pontos de travessia do rio; e, assim que os perseguidores saíram, o portão foi fechado.
pt.R: Então os homens do rei foram atrás dos espiões. Eles pegaram a estrada que ia para o rio Jordão e foram até os lugares onde as pessoas atravessavam o rio. Assim que eles saíram, o portão da cidade foi fechado.

am.L: ሰዎቹም በዮርዳኖስ መንገድ እስከ መሻገሪያዎቹ ድረስ ተከታተሏቸው፤ አሳዳጆቹም ተከትለዋቸው እንደ ወጡ በሩን ዘጉ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ሰዎቹ በዮርዳኖስ መንገድ እስከ ወንዙ መሻገሪያዎች ድረስ ተከተሏቸው፤ አሳዳጆቹም እንደ ወጡ ወዲያው በሩ ተዘጋ።
am.R: ስለዚህ የንጉሡ ሰዎች ሰላዮቹን ተከተሏቸው። ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ የሚወስደውን መንገድ ይዘው ሰዎች ወንዙን እስከሚሻገሩባቸው ስፍራዎች ድረስ ሄዱ። እነርሱም እንደ ወጡ ወዲያው የከተማው በር ተዘጋ።

hi.L: और वे पुरुष यरदन के मार्ग पर घाटों तक उनका पीछा करते गए; और जैसे ही पीछा करनेवाले उनके पीछे निकले, फाटक बंद कर दिया गया।
hi.B: तब वे पुरुष यरदन के मार्ग पर नदी के घाटों तक उनका पीछा करने निकल पड़े, और पीछा करनेवालों के निकलते ही फाटक बंद कर दिया गया।
hi.R: तब राजा के आदमी भेदियों के पीछे गए। उन्होंने यरदन नदी की ओर जानेवाला रास्ता पकड़ा और उन जगहों तक गए जहाँ से लोग नदी पार करते थे। उनके निकलते ही नगर का फाटक बंद कर दिया गया।

ru.L: И мужи погнались за ними по дороге к Иордану, до бродов; а ворота закрыли, как только вышли преследовавшие их.
ru.B: Те люди пустились за ними в погоню по дороге к Иордану, до самых переправ через реку, и как только преследователи вышли, ворота закрыли.
ru.R: Люди царя отправились искать разведчиков. Они пошли по дороге к реке Иордан и дошли до мест, где её переходят вброд. Как только они вышли, городские ворота закрыли.

uk.L: І ті чоловіки гналися за ними дорогою до Йордану, до бродів; а браму зачинили, щойно вийшли ті, що гналися за ними.
uk.B: Тож чоловіки кинулися за ними дорогою до Йордану, аж до переправ, а щойно погоня вийшла, браму зачинили.
uk.R: Тож царські люди пустилися навздогін за вивідувачами. Вони пішли дорогою до річки Йордан і дійшли до місць, де її переходять убрід. Щойно вони вийшли, міську браму зачинили.

decisions.choice: the fords: shallow places where the Jordan could be crossed
decisions.reason: The pursuers assume the spies are heading back east to Israel's camp. The river was in flood at this season (3:15), so the fords were the only way over.

decisions.choice: the gate shut behind the pursuers
decisions.reason: The closed gate shuts the spies inside the city; their only way out is the one Rahab gives them (verse 15).

decisions.choice: river crossings (B); places where people cross it (R)
decisions.reason: "Fords" is less familiar to many readers; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: "घाटों" (the fords)
decisions.reason: The fords are the shallow places where the Jordan could be crossed (m1). "घाट" is the Hindi word for a river crossing; Readable says it in plain words, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וְהֵ֖מָּה טֶ֣רֶם יִשְׁכָּב֑וּן וְהִ֛יא עָלְתָ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־הַגָּֽג׃

records.literal_gloss: And they, before they lay down, and she went up to them on the roof,

en.L: And before they lay down, she came up to them on the roof,
en.B: Before the men lay down to sleep, she came up to them on the roof
en.R: Before the spies lay down to sleep, Rahab went up to them on the roof.

sw.L: Nao kabla hawajalala, yeye alipanda kwao juu ya dari,
sw.B: Kabla watu hao hawajalala, Rahabu alipanda kwao juu ya dari,
sw.R: Kabla wale wapelelezi hawajalala, Rahabu alipanda kwao juu ya dari.

es.L: Y antes de que ellos se acostaran, ella subió a donde estaban, a la azotea,
es.B: Antes de que los hombres se acostaran a dormir, ella subió a la azotea, donde estaban,
es.R: Antes de que los espías se acostaran a dormir, Rahab subió a la azotea, donde estaban ellos.

fr.L: Et eux, avant qu’ils se couchent, elle monta vers eux sur le toit,
fr.B: Avant que les hommes se couchent pour dormir, elle monta les trouver sur le toit
fr.R: Avant que les espions se couchent pour dormir, Rahab est montée les voir sur le toit.

vi.L: Và trước khi họ nằm ngủ, nàng lên với họ trên mái nhà,
vi.B: Trước khi hai người nằm ngủ, nàng lên mái nhà gặp họ
vi.R: Trước khi hai người do thám nằm ngủ, Ra-háp lên mái nhà gặp họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 눕기 전에, 그 여자가 지붕 위에 있는 그들에게 올라와서
ko.B: 그 사람들이 잠자리에 들기 전에 라합이 지붕 위로 그들에게 올라와서
ko.R: 정탐꾼들이 잠자리에 들기 전에 라합이 지붕 위로 그들에게 올라갔다.

pt.L: E, antes que eles se deitassem, ela subiu até eles no terraço
pt.B: Antes que os homens se deitassem para dormir, ela subiu até eles no terraço
pt.R: Antes de os espiões se deitarem para dormir, Raabe subiu até onde eles estavam, no terraço.

am.L: ሰዎቹም ገና ሳይተኙ እርሷ በጣሪያው ላይ ወደ እነርሱ ወጥታ፣
am.B: ሰዎቹ ለመተኛት ገና ሳይጋደሙ እርሷ በጣሪያው ላይ ወደ እነርሱ ወጥታ
am.R: ሰላዮቹ ለመተኛት ገና ሳይጋደሙ ረዓብ በጣሪያው ላይ ወደ እነርሱ ወጣች።

hi.L: और उनके लेटने से पहले वह छत पर उनके पास ऊपर आई,
hi.B: उन पुरुषों के सोने के लिए लेटने से पहले वह छत पर उनके पास आई
hi.R: भेदियों के सोने से पहले राहाब छत पर उनके पास गई।

ru.L: А они ещё не легли, и она поднялась к ним на кровлю,
ru.B: Прежде чем мужчины легли спать, она поднялась к ним на крышу
ru.R: Ещё до того, как разведчики легли спать, Раав поднялась к ним на крышу.

uk.L: А вони ще не лягли, і вона піднялася до них на дах,
uk.B: Перш ніж чоловіки лягли спати, вона піднялася до них на дах
uk.R: Перш ніж вивідувачі лягли спати, Рахав піднялася до них на дах.

decisions.choice: before they lay down: before they settled for the night
decisions.reason: This takes up "they lay down there" from verse 1: the men had not yet gone to sleep when she came to them.

source.text: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי־נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכִֽי־נָפְלָ֤ה אֵֽימַתְכֶם֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְכִ֥י נָמֹ֛גוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and she said to the men, I know that has given YHWH to you the land, and that has fallen dread of you on us, and that have melted all [the] inhabitants of the land before you.

en.L: and she said to the men, "I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has given you the land, and that the dread of you has fallen on us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.
en.B: and told them, "I know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has given this land to you. Terror of you has fallen on us, and everyone who lives in the land is melting in fear before you.
en.R: She said to them, "I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has given this land to you. We are terrified of you. Everyone who lives here is weak with fear because of you.

sw.L: akawaambia wale watu, "Najua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewapa nchi hii, na kwamba hofu yenu imetuangukia, na kwamba wakazi wote wa nchi wanayeyuka mbele yenu.
sw.B: akawaambia, "Najua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewapa ninyi nchi hii. Hofu yenu imetuangukia, na wote wanaoishi katika nchi hii wanayeyuka kwa woga mbele yenu.
sw.R: Akawaambia, "Najua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewapa ninyi nchi hii. Tunawaogopa sana. Kila mtu anayeishi hapa amekosa nguvu kwa sababu ya kuwaogopa ninyi.

es.L: y dijo a los hombres: «Sé que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado la tierra, y que el terror a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ha caído sobre nosotros, y que todos los habitantes de la tierra se derriten delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: y les dijo: «Yo sé que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado esta tierra. El terror a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ha caído sobre nosotros, y todos los que viven en esta tierra se derriten de miedo ante {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Ella les dijo: «Yo sé que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado esta tierra. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} tenemos mucho miedo. Todos los que viven aquí están sin fuerzas por el miedo que {{plural_you:les|os}} tienen.

fr.L: et elle dit aux hommes : « Je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a donné le pays, et que la terreur de vous est tombée sur nous, et que tous les habitants du pays fondent devant vous.
fr.B: et leur dit : « Je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a donné ce pays. La terreur que vous inspirez est tombée sur nous, et tous les habitants du pays fondent de peur devant vous.
fr.R: Elle leur a dit : « Je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a donné ce pays. Nous avons très peur de vous. Tous les habitants d’ici tremblent de peur à cause de vous.

vi.L: và nàng nói với những người ấy: "Tôi biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban xứ này cho các ông, và rằng sự kinh hãi về các ông đã giáng trên chúng tôi, và rằng mọi dân cư trong xứ đều tan chảy trước mặt các ông.
vi.B: và nói: "Tôi biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban xứ này cho các ông. Sự kinh hãi về các ông đã giáng trên chúng tôi, và mọi người sống trong xứ đều tan chảy vì sợ các ông.
vi.R: Nàng nói với họ: "Tôi biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban xứ này cho các ông. Chúng tôi rất sợ các ông. Mọi người sống ở đây đều run rẩy, rụng rời vì các ông.

ko.L: 그 사람들에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 땅을 당신들에게 주신 것과, 당신들에 대한 두려움이 우리에게 닥쳤고, 이 땅의 모든 주민이 당신들 앞에서 녹아내리고 있다는 것을 저는 압니다.
ko.B: 그들에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 땅을 당신들에게 주신 것을 저는 압니다. 당신들 때문에 우리는 두려움에 사로잡혔고, 이 땅에 사는 사람들은 모두 당신들 앞에서 두려워 간담이 녹고 있습니다.
ko.R: 라합이 그들에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 땅을 당신들에게 주신 것을 저는 압니다. 우리는 당신들을 몹시 두려워하고 있습니다. 이곳에 사는 사람들은 모두 당신들 때문에 두려워서 힘이 다 빠졌습니다.

pt.L: e disse aos homens: "Eu sei que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu a vocês a terra, e que o pavor de vocês caiu sobre nós, e que todos os habitantes da terra se derretem diante de vocês.
pt.B: e disse a eles: "Eu sei que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu esta terra a vocês. O pavor de vocês caiu sobre nós, e todos os que moram na terra estão se derretendo de medo diante de vocês.
pt.R: Ela disse a eles: "Eu sei que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu esta terra a vocês. Estamos apavorados por causa de vocês. Todos os que moram aqui estão sem forças de tanto medo de vocês.

am.L: ሰዎቹን እንዲህ አለቻቸው፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምድሪቱን እንደ ሰጣችሁ፣ እናንተን መፍራትም በላያችን እንደ ወደቀ፣ የምድሪቱም ነዋሪዎች ሁሉ በፊታችሁ እንደሚቀልጡ አውቃለሁ።
am.B: እንዲህ አለቻቸው፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህችን ምድር ለእናንተ እንደ ሰጣችሁ አውቃለሁ። እናንተን መፍራት በላያችን ወድቋል፤ በምድሪቱ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ በፊታችሁ በፍርሃት እየቀለጡ ነው።
am.R: እንዲህም አለቻቸው፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህችን ምድር ለእናንተ እንደ ሰጣችሁ አውቃለሁ። እኛ እናንተን እጅግ ፈርተናል። በዚህ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ከእናንተ የተነሣ በፍርሃት ወኔ ከድቷቸዋል።

hi.L: और उसने उन पुरुषों से कहा, "मैं जानती हूँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह देश तुम्हें दे दिया है, और कि तुम्हारा भय हम पर छा गया है, और कि देश के सब निवासी तुम्हारे सामने गल गए हैं।
hi.B: और उनसे कहा, "मैं जानती हूँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह देश तुम्हें दे दिया है। तुम्हारा आतंक हम पर छा गया है, और इस देश के सब निवासी तुम्हारे सामने डर से गले जा रहे हैं।
hi.R: उसने उनसे कहा, "मैं जानती हूँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह देश तुम्हें दे दिया है। हम तुमसे बहुत डरे हुए हैं। यहाँ रहनेवाले सब लोग तुम्हारे कारण डर के मारे हिम्मत हार बैठे हैं।

ru.L: и сказала мужам: «Я знаю, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал вам землю, и что напал на нас ужас перед вами, и что растаяли перед вами все жители земли.
ru.B: и сказала им: «Я знаю, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} отдал вам эту землю. На нас напал ужас перед вами, и все жители этой земли пали духом перед вами.
ru.R: Она сказала им: «Я знаю, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} отдал вам эту землю. Мы в ужасе перед вами. Все, кто здесь живёт, обессилели от страха перед вами.

uk.L: і сказала тим чоловікам: «Я знаю, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав вам цю землю, і що страх перед вами напав на нас, і що всі мешканці цієї землі тануть перед вами.
uk.B: і сказала їм: «Я знаю, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} віддав вам цю землю. Жах перед вами напав на нас, і всі, хто живе в цьому краї, тануть від страху перед вами.
uk.R: Вона сказала їм: «Я знаю, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав вам цю землю. Ми дуже вас боїмося. Усі, хто тут живе, знесилені від страху перед вами.

decisions.choice: I know that the LORD has given you the land
decisions.reason: Rahab, a Canaanite, speaks of Israel's God by his name and says first what his promise has already settled (1:2-3). The spies repeat her words to Joshua (verse 24).

decisions.choice: dread has fallen ... melt away: the words of the Song of the Sea
decisions.reason: Moses' song foretold that the people of Canaan would melt away and that dread and fear would fall on them (Exodus 15:15-16; see Deuteronomy 2:25; 11:25). Rahab says it has happened.

decisions.choice: melt away: lose all courage
decisions.reason: A heart that melts is one that has lost its courage (verse 11; 5:1; Deuteronomy 20:8).

decisions.choice: melting in fear (B); weak with fear (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture and adds "in fear" so it is clear; Readable gives its sense (m3).

decisions.choice: plural "you" (ustedes / vosotros) when Rahab speaks to the spies
decisions.reason: Rahab speaks to the two men together, so Spanish uses the plural forms; the spies answer her with "tú", and the king's message to her also uses "tú".

decisions.choice: "tan chảy" (L), "tan chảy vì sợ" (B), "run rẩy, rụng rời" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture of melting, which recalls the Song of the Sea (m2); Balanced adds "vì sợ" so it is clear the melting is fear (m3). Readable says how fear feels in a plain Vietnamese phrase.

decisions.choice: Rahab and the spies speak to each other in the formal polite style (합쇼체), with "당신들" and "저"
alternatives: the plain style from the spies to Rahab
decisions.reason: They are strangers bargaining for their lives, and the terms of this translation set the formal polite style between strangers and hosts, as in Genesis.

decisions.choice: se derretem (L); estão se derretendo de medo (B); estão sem forças de tanto medo (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also verse 24; 5:1; 7:5; 14:8). The picture of melting (m3) is the word of the Song of the Sea, which Exodus 15:15 keeps at Literal in Portuguese ("derreteram-se"); Rahab says that the song has come true (m2). Balanced keeps the picture and adds "de medo", as the English adds "in fear"; Readable gives its sense.

decisions.choice: "እናንተን መፍራት በላያችን ወደቀ" and "ቀለጡ" (L, B: "melt"), "ወኔ ከድቷቸዋል" (R: "their courage has failed them"), the same words in 2:24 and 5:1
decisions.reason: Rahab uses the words of the Song of the Sea (Exodus 15:15-16), whose Amharic has "ፍርሃት በላያቸው ወደቀ", "ቀለጡ" and, at Readable, "ወኔ ከዳቸው"; keeping them lets the echo be heard.

decisions.choice: "गल गए हैं" (L); "डर से गले जा रहे हैं" (B) for "melt away"
decisions.reason: The words echo the Song of the Sea (m2), where Exodus 15:15 in this translation says "कनान के सब निवासी गल गए"; Balanced adds "डर से" so the picture is clear, and Readable gives its sense, losing all courage (m3).

decisions.choice: "तुम" between Rahab and the spies
decisions.reason: Rahab and the two men speak to each other as equals with "तुम" through the chapter; the king's messengers also say "तुम" to her, and she to them.

decisions.choice: растаяли (L); пали духом (B); обессилели от страха (R)
decisions.reason: Rahab uses the words of the Song of the Sea, rendered in Exodus 15:15 here as растаяли (L) and пали духом (B). The same wording returns in verse 24 when the spies report her words.

source.text: כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֵ֠ת אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִ֨ישׁ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־מֵ֤י יַם־סוּף֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם בְּצֵאתְכֶ֖ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֡ם לִשְׁנֵי֩ מַלְכֵ֨י הָאֱמֹרִ֜י אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ לְסִיחֹ֣ן וּלְע֔וֹג אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱרַמְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For we have heard how dried up YHWH [the] waters of [the] Sea of Reeds before you when you came out from Egypt, and what you did to [the] two kings of the Amorite[s] who [were] across the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you devoted to destruction.

en.L: For we have heard how {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} dried up the waters of the Sea of Reeds before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites who [were] across the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you devoted to destruction.
en.B: We have heard how {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the water of the Red Sea dry up before you as you left Egypt. And we have heard how you dealt with the two Amorite kings across the Jordan, Sihon and Og: you devoted them to destruction.
en.R: We heard that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the Red Sea dry up for you when you came out of Egypt. We also heard what you did to Sihon and Og, the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River. You destroyed them completely, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana tumesikia jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoyakausha maji ya Bahari ya Matete mbele yenu mlipotoka Misri, na mambo mliyowatendea wafalme wawili wa Waamori waliokuwa ng'ambo ya Yordani, Sihoni na Ogu, ambao mliwaweka wakfu kwa maangamizi.
sw.B: Tumesikia jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoyakausha maji ya Bahari ya Shamu mbele yenu mlipotoka Misri. Tena tumesikia mlivyowatendea wale wafalme wawili wa Waamori ng'ambo ya Yordani, Sihoni na Ogu: mliwaweka wakfu kwa maangamizi.
sw.R: Tulisikia kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliikausha Bahari ya Shamu kwa ajili yenu mlipotoka Misri. Tulisikia pia mambo mliyowatendea Sihoni na Ogu, wafalme wawili wa Waamori upande wa mashariki wa Mto Yordani. Mliwaangamiza kabisa, kama watu waliotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Porque hemos oído cómo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} secó las aguas del mar de los Juncos delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuando {{plural_you:salieron|salisteis}} de Egipto, y lo que {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} a los dos reyes de los amorreos que [estaban] al otro lado del Jordán, a Sijón y a Og, a quienes {{plural_you:consagraron|consagrasteis}} al exterminio.
es.B: Hemos oído cómo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} secó el agua del mar Rojo delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuando {{plural_you:salieron|salisteis}} de Egipto. Y hemos oído lo que {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} con los dos reyes amorreos del otro lado del Jordán, Sijón y Og: los {{plural_you:consagraron|consagrasteis}} al exterminio.
es.R: Oímos que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} secó el mar Rojo para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuando {{plural_you:salieron|salisteis}} de Egipto. También oímos lo que les {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} a Sijón y a Og, los dos reyes amorreos del otro lado del río Jordán, al este. {{plural_you:Los destruyeron|Los destruisteis}} por completo, como pueblos entregados {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Car nous avons entendu comment {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a asséché les eaux de la mer des Joncs devant vous quand vous êtes sortis d’Égypte, et ce que vous avez fait aux deux rois des Amoréens qui [étaient] de l’autre côté du Jourdain, à Sihon et à Og, que vous avez voués à l’interdit.
fr.B: Nous avons appris comment {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a asséché devant vous les eaux de la mer Rouge, quand vous êtes sortis d’Égypte. Et nous avons appris comment vous avez traité les deux rois amoréens de l’autre côté du Jourdain, Sihon et Og : vous les avez voués à l’interdit.
fr.R: Nous avons appris que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a asséché la mer Rouge pour vous quand vous êtes sortis d’Égypte. Nous avons aussi appris ce que vous avez fait à Sihon et à Og, les deux rois amoréens à l’est du Jourdain. Vous les avez entièrement détruits, en les livrant {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Vì chúng tôi đã nghe {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm khô nước Biển Sậy trước mặt các ông thế nào khi các ông ra khỏi Ai Cập, và điều các ông đã làm cho hai vua của người A-mô-rít ở bên kia sông Giô-đanh, là Si-hôn và Óc, mà các ông đã tận diệt.
vi.B: Chúng tôi đã nghe {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho nước Biển Đỏ khô cạn trước mặt các ông khi các ông ra khỏi Ai Cập. Chúng tôi cũng đã nghe các ông đối xử thế nào với hai vua A-mô-rít ở bên kia sông Giô-đanh là Si-hôn và Óc: các ông đã tận diệt họ.
vi.R: Chúng tôi đã nghe {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho Biển Đỏ khô cạn để các ông đi qua khi các ông ra khỏi Ai Cập. Chúng tôi cũng nghe điều các ông đã làm cho Si-hôn và Óc, hai vua A-mô-rít ở phía đông sông Giô-đanh. Các ông đã hủy diệt họ hoàn toàn, như dâng họ cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 당신들이 이집트에서 나올 때에 당신들 앞에서 갈대 바다의 물을 마르게 하신 일과, 당신들이 요단 저편에 있던 아모리 사람들의 두 왕, 곧 시혼과 옥에게 한 일, 곧 당신들이 그들을 진멸한 일을 우리가 들었기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 당신들이 이집트에서 나올 때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 당신들 앞에서 홍해의 물을 마르게 하신 일을 우리가 들었습니다. 또 당신들이 요단강 건너편에 있던 아모리 사람들의 두 왕 시혼과 옥을 어떻게 했는지도 들었습니다. 당신들은 그들을 진멸했습니다.
ko.R: 당신들이 이집트에서 나올 때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 당신들을 위해 홍해를 마르게 하셨다는 말을 우리가 들었습니다. 또 당신들이 요단강 동쪽에 있던 아모리 사람들의 두 왕 시혼과 옥에게 한 일도 들었습니다. 당신들은 그들을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바쳐 완전히 멸했습니다.

pt.L: Pois ouvimos como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} secou as águas do mar dos Juncos diante de vocês quando vocês saíram do Egito, e o que vocês fizeram aos dois reis dos amorreus que [estavam] além do Jordão, a Seom e a Ogue, que vocês consagraram à destruição.
pt.B: Ouvimos como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez secar as águas do mar Vermelho diante de vocês quando saíram do Egito. E ouvimos o que vocês fizeram com os dois reis amorreus do outro lado do Jordão, Seom e Ogue: vocês os consagraram à destruição.
pt.R: Ouvimos dizer que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez secar o mar Vermelho para vocês quando saíram do Egito. Ouvimos também o que vocês fizeram com Seom e Ogue, os dois reis amorreus a leste do rio Jordão. Vocês os destruíram completamente, como povos entregues {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: ከግብፅ በወጣችሁ ጊዜ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሸምበቆን ባሕር ውኃ በፊታችሁ እንዴት እንዳደረቀ፣ በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ በነበሩት በሁለቱ የአሞራውያን ነገሥታት በሴዎንና በዐግ ላይ ያደረጋችሁትን፣ ለጥፋትም የለያችኋቸውን ሰምተናልና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከግብፅ ስትወጡ የቀይ ባሕርን ውኃ በፊታችሁ እንዴት እንዳደረቀ ሰምተናል። በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በነበሩት በሁለቱ የአሞራውያን ነገሥታት በሴዎንና በዐግ ላይ ያደረጋችሁትንም ሰምተናል፤ ፈጽማችሁ ለጥፋት ለያችኋቸው።
am.R: ከግብፅ በወጣችሁ ጊዜ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቀይ ባሕርን ለእናንተ እንዳደረቀው ሰምተናል። ደግሞም ከዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ በምሥራቅ የነበሩትን ሁለቱን የአሞራውያን ነገሥታት ሴዎንንና ዐግን ምን እንዳደረጋችኋቸው ሰምተናል። {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የተለዩ አድርጋችሁ ፈጽማችሁ አጠፋችኋቸው።

hi.L: क्योंकि हमने सुना है कि जब तुम मिस्र से निकले, तो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने तुम्हारे सामने सरकंडों के समुद्र का पानी कैसे सुखा दिया, और तुमने एमोरियों के उन दो राजाओं, सीहोन और ओग, के साथ क्या किया जो यरदन के पार [थे], जिन्हें तुमने सर्वनाश के लिए अर्पित कर दिया।
hi.B: हमने सुना है कि जब तुम मिस्र से निकल रहे थे, तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने तुम्हारे सामने लाल समुद्र का पानी कैसे सुखा दिया। और हमने यह भी सुना है कि तुमने यरदन के पार के दो एमोरी राजाओं, सीहोन और ओग, के साथ क्या किया: तुमने उन्हें सर्वनाश के लिए अर्पित कर दिया।
hi.R: हमने सुना कि जब तुम मिस्र से निकले, तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने तुम्हारे लिए लाल समुद्र को सुखा दिया। हमने यह भी सुना कि तुमने यरदन नदी के पूर्व के दो एमोरी राजाओं, सीहोन और ओग, के साथ क्या किया। तुमने उन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को अर्पित मानकर पूरी तरह नष्ट कर दिया।

ru.L: Ведь мы слышали, как {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} иссушил воды Тростникового моря перед вами, когда вы выходили из Египта, и что вы сделали с двумя царями аморреев, которые [были] за Иорданом, с Сигоном и с Огом, которых вы предали заклятию.
ru.B: Мы слышали, как {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} иссушил перед вами воду Красного моря, когда вы выходили из Египта. И мы слышали, как вы поступили с двумя аморрейскими царями за Иорданом, Сигоном и Огом: вы предали их заклятию.
ru.R: Мы слышали, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} осушил для вас Красное море, когда вы вышли из Египта. Мы слышали и о том, что вы сделали с Сигоном и Огом, двумя аморрейскими царями к востоку от реки Иордан. Вы полностью уничтожили их, отдав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.

uk.L: Бо ми чули, як {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} висушив води Очеретяного моря перед вами, коли ви виходили з Єгипту, і що ви зробили двом аморейським царям, які [були] по той бік Йордану, Сигонові й Огові, яких ви віддали на знищення.
uk.B: Ми чули, як {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} висушив перед вами воду Червоного моря, коли ви виходили з Єгипту. І ми чули, як ви вчинили з двома аморейськими царями по той бік Йордану, Сигоном і Огом: ви віддали їх на знищення.
uk.R: Ми чули, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} висушив для вас Червоне море, коли ви вийшли з Єгипту. Ми чули також, що ви зробили з Сигоном і Огом, двома аморейськими царями на схід від річки Йордан. Ви повністю знищили їх, віддавши {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: the LORD dried up the Sea of Reeds
decisions.reason: The crossing of the sea (Exodus 14:21-22) happened forty years earlier, and the news still frightens Canaan. In 4:23 Joshua sets the crossing of the Jordan beside it.

decisions.choice: across the Jordan: here, east of it
decisions.reason: The phrase names the far side of the river from where the speaker stands. Rahab is in Jericho, west of the Jordan, so she means the land east of it, where Sihon and Og ruled.

decisions.choice: Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites
decisions.reason: Israel defeated Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan and took their lands (Numbers 21:21-35; Deuteronomy 2:26-3:11).

decisions.choice: devoted to destruction: given over to God completely
decisions.reason: The verb is the one for a "devoted thing" (Leviticus 27:28-29). In war it means a people was destroyed and none were kept for gain, as with Sihon and Og (Deuteronomy 2:34; 3:6).

decisions.choice: the Red Sea
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is "Sea of Reeds", which Literal keeps. Balanced and Readable use the familiar name for the sea Israel crossed, as Exodus does.

decisions.choice: destroyed them completely, as given over to the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable explains the term as in Deuteronomy 2:34 (m4).

decisions.choice: "kuweka wakfu kwa maangamizi" (L, B); "kuangamiza kabisa, kama watu waliotolewa kwa BWANA" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Joshua, as in Deuteronomy: herem is giving people or things over wholly to God, so that nothing is kept for oneself. Literal and Balanced say "kuweka wakfu kwa maangamizi" (to set apart for destruction), and the devoted thing is "kitu kilichowekwa wakfu kwa maangamizi"; Readable says "kuangamiza kabisa" and names the LORD, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Bahari ya Matete" (L); "Bahari ya Shamu" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch: Literal keeps the Hebrew name, "Sea of Reeds"; Balanced and Readable use "Bahari ya Shamu", the name Swahili readers know, as the English says "the Red Sea".

decisions.choice: "consagrar al exterminio" (Literal, Balanced); "destruir por completo, como pueblos entregados al SEÑOR" (Readable)
decisions.reason: This is the first use in Joshua of the Hebrew herem, to give something over to God by destroying it. Following the terms note for these books, Literal and Balanced say "consagrar al exterminio" and the thing so given is "lo consagrado al exterminio"; Readable says "destruir por completo" and, as the English does, explains whom it was given over to.

decisions.choice: "vouer à l'interdit" (Literal, Balanced); "détruire entièrement" with "en les livrant au SEIGNEUR" (Readable)
alternatives: "anéantir" with no word of giving to God
decisions.reason: For the whole of Joshua 1-12, as the terms note sets: the Hebrew word means handing people or things over to God so completely that nothing is kept for human use, and in war that meant destruction. "Vouer à l'interdit" is the established French term for it; Readable says plainly that they were destroyed entirely and adds, as the English does, that they were given over to the LORD.

decisions.choice: "tận diệt" (L, B), "hủy diệt ... hoàn toàn, như dâng ... cho CHÚA" (R)
decisions.reason: The word for giving a people or a thing over to God for destruction (m4), its first use in this block. The terms note for these books sets "tận diệt" for the verb and "vật bị nguyền để hủy diệt" for the thing devoted; Readable says "hủy diệt hoàn toàn" and adds what makes it more than slaughter, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Biển Sậy" (L), "Biển Đỏ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is "Sea of Reeds"; Literal keeps it, and Balanced and Readable use the name readers know, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "진멸하다" (L, B); "주께 바쳐 완전히 멸하다" (R), for the whole block
alternatives: "전멸시키다", which says only that all were killed
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means to give something wholly over to God by destroying it. "진멸하다" is the Bible word for this; Readable says it in plain words and keeps the part about giving it over to the LORD, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: consagrar à destruição (L, B); destruir completamente, como povos entregues ao SENHOR (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the verb of the ban (m4) keeps Deuteronomy's wording (Deuteronomy 2:34; 7:2; 20:17): "consagrar à destruição" at Literal and Balanced, which keeps both halves of the sense, given over to God and destroyed; Readable says it in plain words and adds to whom, as the English Readable does. The noun, "the devoted things" (6:17-18; 7:1), is "o que está consagrado à destruição".

decisions.choice: o mar dos Juncos (L); o mar Vermelho (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 4:23; 24:6), as Exodus 10:19 sets it in Portuguese: Literal translates the Hebrew name, Balanced and Readable use the name Portuguese readers know. "Seom" and "Ogue" are the forms Numbers 21 and Deuteronomy use.

decisions.choice: For the whole of Joshua, ḥerem ("devote to destruction") is "ለጥፋት መለየት" (L, B), and at Readable "ለእግዚአብሔር የተለዩ አድርጎ ፈጽሞ ማጥፋት", with the divine-name span, as Deuteronomy 7:2; yam suf is "የሸምበቆ ባሕር" (L), "ቀይ ባሕር" (B, R), as in Exodus
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means handing something over wholly to God, which here meant destroying it; "ለጥፋት መለየት" keeps both ideas, and Readable says them in two plain parts as its English level does. The sea's name follows the Pentateuch's settled choice.

decisions.choice: "सरकंडों के समुद्र" (L), "लाल समुद्र" (B, R); "सर्वनाश के लिए अर्पित करना" (L, B), "प्रभु को अर्पित मानकर पूरी तरह नष्ट करना" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy 11:4, Literal keeps the Hebrew name, "Sea of Reeds", and Balanced and Readable use the familiar name, as Acts 7:36 does. The verb herem keeps the wording of Deuteronomy 2:34 (m4): giving something over to God by destroying it completely. The same through Joshua.

decisions.choice: предать заклятию (L, B); полностью уничтожить, отдав ГОСПОДУ (R)
decisions.reason: The ban (herem) as Deuteronomy 7:2 and 20:17 render it in this translation: заклятие at Literal and Balanced, and at Readable a plain explanation that the thing was given over to the LORD by being destroyed. This holds for the whole book (Jericho, Ai, the southern and northern campaigns).

decisions.choice: Тростниковое море (L); Красное море (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus in this translation: Literal keeps the Hebrew name, Balanced and Readable the familiar one.

decisions.choice: for herem through the book: "віддати на знищення" (L, B), "повністю знищити, віддавши ГОСПОДУ" (R); the thing devoted is "віддане на знищення" (L, B) / "те, що належало знищити" (R), and in the story of Achan "віддане на знищення" at every level
decisions.reason: Herem is the giving over of a people or a thing wholly to God, which meant its destruction (meaning note). "Віддати на знищення" says both the handing over and its end in plain modern words; "закляття" now reads as a curse or spell. Readable says it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Очеретяне море" (L), "Червоне море" (B, R); "Сигон", "Ог", "амореї"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew name, as the English "Sea of Reeds"; Balanced and Readable give the familiar one, as the English does.

source.text: וַנִּשְׁמַע֙ וַיִּמַּ֣ס לְבָבֵ֔נוּ וְלֹא־קָ֨מָה ע֥וֹד ר֛וּחַ בְּאִ֖ישׁ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֤וּא אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּֽחַת׃

records.literal_gloss: And we heard, and melted our heart, and not rose again spirit in [any] man because of you, for YHWH your God, he [is] God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath.

en.L: And we heard, and our heart melted, and there did not rise up any more spirit in anyone because of you; for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath.
en.B: When we heard it, our hearts melted, and no one had any courage left because of you, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is God in heaven above and on earth below.
en.R: When we heard these things, we were filled with fear. No one has any courage left to fight you, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is God of the heavens above and of the earth below.

sw.L: Tukasikia, na moyo wetu ukayeyuka, wala haikuinuka tena roho ndani ya mtu yeyote kwa sababu yenu; kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ni] Mungu katika mbingu juu na katika nchi chini.
sw.B: Tuliposikia hayo mioyo yetu iliyeyuka, wala hakuna mtu aliyebaki na ujasiri kwa sababu yenu, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ndiye Mungu mbinguni juu na duniani chini.
sw.R: Tuliposikia mambo hayo, tulijawa na hofu. Hakuna mtu aliyebaki na ujasiri wa kupigana nanyi, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ndiye Mungu wa mbingu zilizo juu na wa dunia iliyo chini.

es.L: Y lo oímos, y se derritió nuestro corazón, y ya no se levantó ánimo en nadie por causa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] Dios arriba en los cielos y abajo en la tierra.
es.B: Al oírlo, se nos derritió el corazón, y a nadie le quedó valor por causa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} es Dios arriba en el cielo y abajo en la tierra.
es.R: Cuando oímos estas cosas, nos llenamos de miedo. A nadie le queda valor para pelear contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} es Dios de los cielos, arriba, y de la tierra, abajo.

fr.L: Et nous avons entendu, et notre cœur a fondu, et il ne s’est plus levé de souffle en personne à cause de vous ; car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [est] Dieu dans les cieux en haut et sur la terre en bas.
fr.B: Quand nous l’avons appris, notre cœur a fondu, et personne n’a plus de courage à cause de vous, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu est Dieu dans les cieux en haut et sur la terre en bas.
fr.R: Quand nous avons appris ces choses, nous avons été remplis de peur. Personne n’a plus le courage de vous combattre, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu est le Dieu du ciel, là-haut, et de la terre, ici-bas.

vi.L: Và chúng tôi nghe, thì lòng chúng tôi tan chảy, và không còn ai có chí khí vì các ông nữa; vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ông, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời ở trên trời cao và ở dưới đất thấp.
vi.B: Khi nghe những điều ấy, lòng chúng tôi tan chảy, và không còn ai đủ can đảm trước các ông, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ông là Đức Chúa Trời ở trên trời cao và ở dưới đất thấp.
vi.R: Khi nghe những điều ấy, chúng tôi đầy sợ hãi. Không còn ai đủ can đảm để chống lại các ông, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ông là Đức Chúa Trời của trời cao và đất thấp.

ko.L: 우리가 듣고 우리 마음이 녹아내렸으며, 당신들 때문에 아무에게도 더 이상 용기가 일어나지 않았습니다. 당신들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분은 위로는 하늘에서, 아래로는 땅에서 하나님이시기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그 소식을 듣고 우리는 간담이 녹았고, 당신들 때문에 아무에게도 용기가 남지 않았습니다. 당신들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위로는 하늘에서, 아래로는 땅에서 하나님이십니다.
ko.R: 우리는 이런 소식을 듣고 두려움에 휩싸였습니다. 당신들과 싸울 용기가 남은 사람은 아무도 없습니다. 당신들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위로 하늘과 아래로 땅을 다스리시는 하나님이시기 때문입니다.

pt.L: E ouvimos, e o nosso coração se derreteu, e não se levantou mais espírito em ninguém por causa de vocês; pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] Deus nos céus em cima e na terra embaixo.
pt.B: Quando ouvimos isso, o nosso coração se derreteu, e ninguém teve mais coragem por causa de vocês, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, é Deus em cima, nos céus, e embaixo, na terra.
pt.R: Quando ouvimos essas coisas, ficamos cheios de medo. Ninguém tem mais coragem para lutar contra vocês, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, é Deus lá em cima, no céu, e aqui embaixo, na terra.

am.L: ሰማን፤ ልባችንም ቀለጠ፤ ከእናንተም የተነሣ በማንም ሰው ዳግመኛ መንፈስ አልተነሣም፤ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ እርሱ በላይ በሰማያት በታችም በምድር አምላክ [ነው]ና።
am.B: ይህን በሰማን ጊዜ ልባችን ቀለጠ፤ ከእናንተም የተነሣ በማንም ዘንድ ወኔ አልቀረም፤ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በላይ በሰማይ በታችም በምድር አምላክ ነውና።
am.R: ይህን በሰማን ጊዜ በፍርሃት ተዋጥን። እናንተን ለመዋጋት ወኔ ያለው አንድም ሰው የለም፤ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በላይ የሰማይ በታችም የምድር አምላክ ነውና።

hi.L: और हमने सुना, और हमारा हृदय गल गया, और तुम्हारे कारण किसी में फिर साहस न रहा; क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर, वे ही ऊपर आकाश में और नीचे पृथ्वी पर परमेश्वर [हैं]।
hi.B: यह सुनते ही हमारे हृदय गल गए, और तुम्हारे कारण किसी में भी साहस न बचा, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ही ऊपर स्वर्ग में और नीचे पृथ्वी पर परमेश्वर हैं।
hi.R: जब हमने ये बातें सुनीं, तो हम डर से भर गए। अब किसी में तुमसे लड़ने की हिम्मत नहीं बची, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ही ऊपर आकाश के और नीचे पृथ्वी के परमेश्वर हैं।

ru.L: И мы услышали, и растаяло сердце наше, и не осталось больше духа ни в ком из-за вас, ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог ваш, — {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} Бог на небесах вверху и на земле внизу.
ru.B: Когда мы услышали это, сердца наши растаяли, и ни у кого не осталось мужества из-за вас, потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, — Бог на небе вверху и на земле внизу.
ru.R: Когда мы услышали об этом, нас охватил страх. Ни у кого больше нет смелости сражаться с вами, потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, — Бог и на небесах вверху, и на земле внизу.

uk.L: І ми почули, і розтануло наше серце, і не стало вже ні в кому духу через вас, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} — Бог на небесах угорі і на землі долі.
uk.B: Коли ми почули це, наші серця розтанули, і ні в кому не залишилося відваги через вас, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, — Бог на небі вгорі і на землі внизу.
uk.R: Коли ми про це почули, нас охопив страх. Ні в кого вже немає відваги битися з вами, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, — Бог неба вгорі і землі внизу.

decisions.choice: no spirit rose up in anyone: no one had courage left
decisions.reason: "Spirit" (ruach) here is a person's breath and vigor; when it does not rise, a person has no will to stand and fight (5:1; 1 Kings 10:5).

decisions.choice: the LORD your God is God in heaven above and on earth beneath
decisions.reason: Rahab's confession uses the words Moses gave Israel to confess (Deuteronomy 4:39). She owns the LORD not as one god among the gods of the nations but as God of all places.

decisions.choice: our hearts melted (B); we were filled with fear (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the Hebrew picture; Readable gives its sense, since the next clause speaks of courage (m1).

decisions.choice: your God is God
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the subject ("he") for emphasis; Literal keeps it, and Balanced and Readable carry the stress in the sentence itself.

decisions.choice: to fight you
decisions.reason: Readable says what the courage would have been for.

decisions.choice: Deus nos céus em cima e na terra embaixo (L); Deus em cima, nos céus, e embaixo, na terra (B); Deus lá em cima, no céu, e aqui embaixo, na terra (R)
decisions.reason: Rahab's confession takes up the words Moses gave Israel (m2), so each level keeps the wording of Deuteronomy 4:39 in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; honorific "वे", "उन्होंने" for God
alternatives: a deity_pronoun span, as in the English
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi, and the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans; respect for God comes from the honorific third person at every level, as in chapter 1.

decisions.choice: "साहस न रहा" for "no spirit rose up"
decisions.reason: Here "spirit" is courage (m1); a word-for-word "आत्मा" would sound like the breath of life or the Spirit, so Literal too says "साहस".

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִשָּֽׁבְעוּ־נָ֥א לִי֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה כִּי־עָשִׂ֥יתִי עִמָּכֶ֖ם חָ֑סֶד וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם גַּם־אַתֶּ֜ם עִם־בֵּ֤ית אָבִי֙ חֶ֔סֶד וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לִ֖י א֥וֹת אֱמֶֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, swear, please, to me by YHWH, since I have done with you steadfast love, that will do also you with [the] house of my father steadfast love, and give to me a sign of truth,

en.L: And now, please swear to me by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, since I have shown you steadfast love, that you also will show steadfast love to my father's house, and give me a sure sign,
en.B: So now, swear to me by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: since I have shown you faithful love, you too will show faithful love to my father's family. Give me a sign I can trust
en.R: I have shown you faithful love. So now, make a promise to me in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Promise that you will show faithful love to my family too. Give me a sign that I can trust.

sw.L: Basi sasa, tafadhali niapieni kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa kuwa nimewatendea fadhili, kwamba ninyi pia mtaitendea fadhili nyumba ya baba yangu, na kunipa ishara ya kweli,
sw.B: Basi sasa, niapieni kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: kwa kuwa nimewatendea fadhili, ninyi pia mtaitendea fadhili jamaa ya baba yangu. Nipeni ishara ninayoweza kuitegemea
sw.R: Nimewatendea fadhili. Basi sasa, niahidini kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ahidini kwamba ninyi pia mtaitendea fadhili jamaa yangu. Nipeni ishara ninayoweza kuiamini.

es.L: Y ahora, por favor, {{plural_you:júrenme|juradme}} por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que, ya que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} he mostrado amor leal, también {{plural_you:ustedes mostrarán|vosotros mostraréis}} amor leal a la casa de mi padre, y {{plural_you:denme|dadme}} una señal segura,
es.B: Así que ahora, {{plural_you:júrenme|juradme}} por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que, ya que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} he mostrado amor fiel, también {{plural_you:ustedes mostrarán|vosotros mostraréis}} amor fiel a la familia de mi padre. {{plural_you:Denme|Dadme}} una señal segura
es.R: Yo {{plural_you:les|os}} he mostrado amor fiel. Así que ahora {{plural_you:prométanme|prometedme}} en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que también {{plural_you:mostrarán|mostraréis}} amor fiel a mi familia. {{plural_you:Denme|Dadme}} una señal en la que yo pueda confiar.

fr.L: Et maintenant, jurez-moi donc par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, puisque j’ai usé de bonté envers vous, que vous aussi vous userez de bonté envers la maison de mon père, et donnez-moi un signe sûr,
fr.B: Maintenant donc, jurez-moi par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : puisque je vous ai traités avec bonté, vous aussi, vous traiterez avec bonté la famille de mon père. Donnez-moi un signe auquel je puisse me fier
fr.R: J’ai été bonne pour vous. Alors maintenant, faites-moi une promesse au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Promettez que vous serez bons, vous aussi, pour ma famille. Donnez-moi un signe auquel je puisse me fier.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, xin hãy nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thề với tôi rằng, vì tôi đã đối xử với các ông bằng lòng nhân từ, thì các ông cũng sẽ đối xử với nhà cha tôi bằng lòng nhân từ, và ban cho tôi một dấu hiệu chắc chắn,
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, xin các ông nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thề với tôi: vì tôi đã đối xử với các ông bằng lòng nhân từ, các ông cũng sẽ đối xử với gia đình cha tôi bằng lòng nhân từ. Xin cho tôi một dấu hiệu đáng tin
vi.R: Tôi đã đối xử tốt và trung tín với các ông. Vậy bây giờ, xin các ông nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hứa với tôi. Xin hứa rằng các ông cũng sẽ đối xử tốt và trung tín với gia đình tôi. Xin cho tôi một dấu hiệu tôi có thể tin được.

ko.L: 그러니 이제 제가 당신들에게 인애를 베풀었으니, 당신들도 제 아버지의 집에 인애를 베풀겠다고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두고 저에게 맹세하고, 저에게 확실한 표를 주십시오.
ko.B: 그러니 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두고 저에게 맹세해 주십시오. 제가 당신들에게 친절을 베풀었으니, 당신들도 제 아버지 집안에 친절을 베풀겠다고 맹세하십시오. 그리고 제가 믿을 수 있는 표를 주십시오.
ko.R: 저는 당신들에게 친절을 베풀었습니다. 그러니 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 저에게 약속해 주십시오. 당신들도 제 가족에게 친절을 베풀겠다고 약속해 주십시오. 그리고 제가 믿을 수 있는 표를 주십시오.

pt.L: E agora, por favor, jurem-me {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}, já que eu usei de lealdade com vocês, que vocês também usarão de lealdade com a casa do meu pai, e me darão um sinal seguro,
pt.B: Agora, então, jurem-me {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}: já que tratei vocês com lealdade, vocês também tratarão com lealdade a família do meu pai. Deem-me um sinal em que eu possa confiar
pt.R: Eu fui bondosa e leal com vocês. Agora, então, façam-me uma promessa em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Prometam que vocês também vão ser bondosos e leais com a minha família. Deem-me um sinal em que eu possa confiar.

am.L: አሁንም እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ጽኑ ፍቅር ስላደረግኩ፣ እናንተም ደግሞ ከአባቴ ቤት ጋር ጽኑ ፍቅር እንድታደርጉ እባካችሁ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ማሉልኝ፤ የእውነትም ምልክት ስጡኝ፤
am.B: ስለዚህ አሁን እኔ ጽኑ ፍቅር እንዳሳየኋችሁ እናንተም ለአባቴ ቤተሰብ ጽኑ ፍቅር እንደምታሳዩ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ማሉልኝ። የምተማመንበትንም ምልክት ስጡኝ፤
am.R: እኔ ጽኑ ፍቅር አሳይቻችኋለሁ። ስለዚህ አሁን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም ቃል ግቡልኝ። ለቤተሰቤም ጽኑ ፍቅር እንደምታሳዩ ቃል ግቡልኝ። የምተማመንበትን ምልክት ስጡኝ።

hi.L: और अब, कृपया {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शपथ खाकर मुझसे कहो कि जैसे मैंने तुम पर अटल प्रेम दिखाया है, वैसे ही तुम भी मेरे पिता के घराने पर अटल प्रेम दिखाओगे, और मुझे एक सच्चा चिह्न दो,

ru.L: И теперь поклянитесь мне, прошу, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, что, раз я оказала вам неизменную любовь, то и вы окажете неизменную любовь дому отца моего, и дайте мне верный знак,
ru.B: Итак, поклянитесь мне {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}: раз я оказала вам милость, то и вы окажете милость семье моего отца. Дайте мне знак, которому я могу верить,
ru.R: Я оказала вам милость. Поэтому теперь дайте мне клятву именем {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Пообещайте, что вы тоже окажете милость моей семье. Дайте мне знак, которому я могу верить.

uk.L: А тепер присягніть мені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, що, як я виявила вам незмінну любов, так і ви виявите незмінну любов до дому мого батька, і дайте мені певний знак,
uk.B: Тож тепер присягніть мені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}: я виявила вам незмінну любов, тож і ви виявите незмінну любов до родини мого батька. Дайте мені знак, якому я можу довіряти,
uk.R: Я виявила вам доброту. Тож тепер пообіцяйте мені іменем {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Пообіцяйте, що й ви будете добрі до моєї родини. Дайте мені знак, якому я можу вірити.

decisions.choice: steadfast love: loyal kindness that keeps faith
decisions.reason: Chesed is goodness shown out of loyalty, the faithfulness one party owes another in a bond. Rahab has acted as the spies' loyal friend, and she asks that the same be done for her family. The word is used of the LORD's covenant love (Exodus 34:6; Deuteronomy 7:9).

decisions.choice: swear to me by the LORD: an oath that calls God to witness
decisions.reason: To swear by the LORD bound the spies before their own God, the one Rahab has just confessed (verse 11). Israel was to swear by his name alone (Deuteronomy 6:13).

decisions.choice: a sign of truth: a sure pledge
alternatives: a token that can be relied on
decisions.reason: "Truth" (emet) here is reliability: something she can hold them to. The oath itself (verse 14) and the scarlet cord (verse 18) give her that assurance.

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 34:6 and Deuteronomy, so that the loyalty in the word is kept; "kindness" alone would leave it out.

decisions.choice: my father's family (B); my family (R)
decisions.reason: "House" means the household, the family under its head; verse 13 lists who is meant.

decisions.choice: "fadhili" at every level
decisions.reason: For the whole of Joshua, following the terms note for these books: hesed shown between people is "fadhili", loyal kindness that keeps faith; "upendo usiokoma" is kept for God's steadfast love. The English says "steadfast love" (Literal) and "faithful love" (Balanced, Readable); Swahili uses the one word at every level.

decisions.choice: "amor leal" (Literal); "amor fiel" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew hesed is the loyal kindness that keeps faith. Spanish follows the words already settled for it in Psalms and in the terms note for these books, and uses them where the English has "steadfast love" and "faithful love", here and in verse 14.

decisions.choice: "bonté" ("user de bonté", "traiter avec bonté") at every level
alternatives: "amour loyal" (Literal) and "amour fidèle" (Balanced, Readable), as for God's love in Psalms
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the one translated "steadfast love" or "faithful love" in English. The terms note keeps "amour loyal" and "amour fidèle" for God's love and uses "bonté" for loyal kindness between people, as here between Rahab and the spies; French "amour" between a woman and two strangers would suggest romance. The loyalty in the word is carried by the oath and, in verse 14, by "fidélité".

decisions.choice: "lòng nhân từ" (L, B), "đối xử tốt và trung tín" (R)
alternatives: "tình yêu thương thành tín", the word used when it is God's love
decisions.reason: The word is loyal kindness that keeps faith (m1). The terms note for these books keeps "tình yêu thương thành tín" for God's love and uses "lòng nhân từ" for this kindness between people; Readable says what it means in plain words, keeping the note of faithfulness.

decisions.choice: "인애" (L); "친절" (B, R) for the loyal kindness (*hesed*) between Rahab and the spies
alternatives: "한결같은 사랑", the word for God's steadfast love
decisions.reason: The terms of this translation keep "한결같은 사랑" for God's steadfast love and use "인애" or "친절" where the loyalty is between people. Literal keeps the Bible word; Balanced and Readable use the everyday word for kindness that keeps faith.

decisions.choice: lealdade (L, B); bondosa e leal, bondosos e leais (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, where hesed is shown between people (also 2:14). The word is goodness that keeps faith (m1). Literal and Balanced say "lealdade", the word 1 and 2 Samuel and Judges 1:24 use in Portuguese for hesed between people, as Genesis 24:49 and 47:29 have it; between a woman and two men, "amor" would suggest romance. Readable turns it into the adjectives "bondosa e leal", keeping both the kindness and the loyalty. God's own hesed stays "amor leal".

decisions.choice: "ጽኑ ፍቅር" for ḥesed at every level (L "ጽኑ ፍቅር ማድረግ", B, R "ጽኑ ፍቅር ማሳየት"); "ጽኑ ፍቅርና ታማኝነት" for ḥesed and ʾemet in 2:14 (L)
decisions.reason: The English moves from "steadfast love" to "faithful love"; "ጽኑ ፍቅር" already says love that holds firm and keeps faith, so one wording serves every level, as in the Pentateuch's terms list.

decisions.choice: Rahab speaks to the two spies with the plural "እናንተ"; they answer her with "አንቺ", and speak of her household with "እናንተ" (2:14)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is plural when she speaks to the two men and when they pledge their lives for her family's, singular when they give her the terms; Amharic marks both on the verb.

decisions.choice: "अटल प्रेम" (L); "कृपा" (B, R) for hesed between people
alternatives: "अटल प्रेम" at every level, as the English "faithful love"
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note settles hesed between people, a favour that keeps faith, as "अटल प्रेम" at Literal and "कृपा" at Balanced and Readable; the loyalty of the word is carried by the oath and the sure sign that go with it (m1, m3). The same in verse 14.

decisions.choice: "मेरे पिता के परिवार" (B); "मेरे परिवार" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note has it for the father's house, Balanced and Readable say "परिवार"; Literal keeps "घराना".

decisions.choice: неизменная любовь (L); милость (B, R)
decisions.reason: Hesed between people, as the Pentateuch note settles: Literal keeps the full word used for God's steadfast love, Balanced and Readable say милость, a kindness done in loyalty. The English says "faithful love" at Balanced; Russian верная любовь would sound romantic here.

decisions.choice: between people, hesed is "незмінна любов" (L, B) and "доброта" (R)
decisions.reason: The Old Testament terms note sets "незмінна любов" (L) and "доброта" (B, R) for a kindness between people; Balanced keeps "незмінна любов" here, as the English Balanced keeps "faithful love", for the oath of loyalty Rahab asks for, and Readable says "доброта".

am.B: ይኸውም አባቴንና እናቴን፣ ወንድሞቼንና እኅቶቼን፣ የእነርሱ የሆኑትንም ሁሉ በሕይወት እንድታኖሩና ከሞት እንድታድኑን ነው።»

decisions.choice: all who belong to them: their households
decisions.reason: The phrase can take in goods as well as people, but the point is life and death, so their wives, children and dependants are meant (6:23).

decisions.choice: our lives: literally "our souls"
decisions.reason: The word (nefesh) means the living person. To deliver someone's nefesh from death is to keep that person alive.

decisions.choice: all their families
decisions.reason: Readable names the people meant (m1).
